jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2661053 Hybrid 108460019 Construction Management Business & Administration MENLO PARK, 145 El Camino Real, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**

As a Program Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting the Business Operations & Strategic Initiatives (BOSI) team within Facilities Services, with a focus on capital construction project coordination, program reporting, and operational support. Working closely with Program Managers, Construction Directors, project teams, and cross-functional partners, you will help coordinate recurring project and program activities, maintain accurate reporting and documentation, and support standardized processes that strengthen project oversight and operational efficiency across a large and evolving construction portfolio.

In this role, you will support a variety of construction-related business and operational functions, including capital project reporting, financial review coordination, resource workload planning and tracking, dashboard maintenance, and program governance activities. Responsibilities include coordinating capital financial review meetings and preparing supporting materials, consolidating project budget and schedule information, maintaining Resource Load Plans (RLPs) and planned-versus-actual hours reporting, tracking project milestones and outstanding action items, and supporting the development and maintenance of project and portfolio dashboards. You will also coordinate stakeholder communications, maintain program documentation, and help ensure critical reporting activities and deliverables remain on schedule.

The Program Coordinator will play an important role in maintaining the accuracy, consistency, and accessibility of project and operational information. Drawing from systems such as PMWeb and other enterprise platforms, you will collect and validate project data, compile performance metrics, identify reporting discrepancies, and prepare materials for Program Managers and leadership review. You will also support process improvement initiatives by maintaining standardized templates, coordinating implementation activities, and helping improve reporting workflows and information management across the construction portfolio.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, analytical aptitude, effective communication, and the ability to independently coordinate multiple activities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is proactive, collaborative, comfortable working with project data and reporting tools, and interested in supporting capital construction initiatives through structured coordination, reliable information management, and continuous process improvement.

Facilities Services enhances health through leadership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team provides essential non-clinical support 24/7, ensuring safe and efficient operations while planning for future growth. We represent the intersection of planning, construction, general services, and facilities operations. Learn more about Facilities Services at Stanford Health Care.

The Business Operations & Strategic Initiatives (BOSI) team supports the operational and strategic functions of Facilities Services, including budgeting, staffing, business process improvement, reporting, and organizational planning. Acting as a bridge between Facilities Services and strategic partners such as Human Resources, Finance, Supply Chain, Technology & Digital Solutions, and Legal, the team drives initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness and enable informed decision-making across the division.

**A Brief Overview**  
The Program Coordinator is responsible for a full range of planning, implementation and support of new and restructured programs that support Stanford Health Care (SHC) business development and customer service. The role is also in charge of planning and managing logistics for client relationship, marketing, and internal operations and others. The incumbent interfaces internally with Stanford Health Care (SHC), Lucile Packard Children's Hospital (LPCH), and School of Medicine (SOM) senior management, Corporate Partners and Executive Health Program Departments, Stanford Alumni networks and Stanford University Departments in all disciplines. External contacts include multinational corporations, medical centers, foundations and individual patients and families who have a relationship with Stanford Health Care.
  
  
The Program Coordinator carries out assigned duties independently and communicates constantly with Management. This role works collaboratively with a broad range of stakeholders in clinical, administrative, ancillary and service departments, and manages communication among all departments and School of Medicine.  
  
  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Leads/supports projects to improve internal operations and overall growth; documents project scope and sets project expectations clearly and precisely
* Institutes workgroups to address necessary processes and procedures required for the existing and new services. Distributes minutes and other relevant communication regarding project activities
* Plans and implements logistics for (1) internal (SHC, LPCH, SOM and SU) communication on behalf of his/her department, (2) for videoconferencing with SHC clients (education, CME, clinical review and second opinion programs), (3) for business and relationship development overseas, including education outreach programs, consulting engagements, events and travel
* Understands Care Coordination workflow and key components to help facilitate patient inquiries and visits as needed.

jobs.title: Medical Student Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Reporting to the Associate Administrative Director, MedEd, the Medical Student Clerkship Coordinator position will provide overall high-level support to Medical Student Education Program primarily by coordinating the Traditional Clerkship, including Clinical Skills Sessions and Didactics series for the traditional clerkship, support of the PISCES Longitudinal Clerkship Clinical Skills Session and site scheduling plus PISCES School didactics. Specific duties include primary interface with all clerkship sites, site administration of the Mission Bay/Mt. Zion clerkship site, proctoring exams 7 times a year; preparing student orientation materials and presentations; assistance with coordinating education program research and student research opportunities alongside the Medical Education Director; primary initiator of clerkship student assessment and grading needs, plus general course coordination. This position also is the point person in coordinating the Volunteer Clinical Professor (VCP) program. The major functions are communicating as the department representative with the volunteer professor and HR representative, managing the volunteer clinical faculty (VCP) database, and producing annual evaluation reports for academic and non-VCP instructors. This position will also interface with ENACT (UCSF-Stanford Endometriosis Center for Discovery, Innovation, Training and Community Engagement) on specifics related to Endometriosis research. This role also serves as backup for the F1 and Undergraduate Research Internship (URI) Administrator on various tasks and provides support to the Associate Administrative Director and Faculty Program Directors. There may be other duties as needed.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mt. Zion and San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $146 million. The Department has 111 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 20 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff. The mission of the UCSF Department of Ob, Gyn & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in Patient Care, Scientific Discovery, Education, Advocacy, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. “Leading the way in women’s health.”

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

Reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities are available as part of the application and interview processes. If you would like to request accommodations, please contact the recruiter or hiring manager. If workplace accommodations are needed after a job offer is made, please contact the supervisor and/or Disability Management Services (DMS) at (415) 476-2621 to initiate the interactive process.

  

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in related areas and minimum 2-3 years’ experience in educational administration and/or academic project coordination (such as logistics or coordination of small to large meetings/events or trainings).
* Basic knowledge of administrative analysis and operations research. Acquiring skills in developing and implementing processes and systems. Familiarity with the administrative and operational implications in a program.
* Ability to analyze, troubleshoot and recommend (and implement) solutions
* Strong skills in verbal, written, and listening communication. Ability to respond to questions and requests in a professional, helpful, and timely manner.
* Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with faculty, staff, learners, and others within the department.
* Excellent organizational and analytical skills, plus demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to work with extremely complex faculty calendars / schedules requires extremely well organized and detail-oriented precision.
* Investigative, data analysis, and reporting skills. Ability to generate computer reports, checking for errors, correcting and submitting accurate reports. Skills include entering, maintaining, extracting, and analyzing data in electronic systems.
* Experience with MS Office Suite applications (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and Zoom and other virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to work independently and with others in a fast paced, deadline driven environment
* Establish and maintain effective interpersonal relationships with all levels of staff and learners within the department.
* Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.  

**Preferred:**

* Basic knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements for Medical Education. Basic knowledge of health professions education industry.
* Knowledge of educational technology and systems. Ability to troubleshoot and triage related technology issues.
* Experience using UCSF systems: MyAccess, Bearbuy, Advance, MyExpense, Oracle, MyTime.
* Knowledge of educational technology and systems. Ability to troubleshoot and triage related technology issues.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**About Lao Family Community Development, Inc.**

Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD) is a community-based non-profit organization established in Richmond, Contra Costa County, California, in 1980. Since then, LFCD has expanded its operations to Alameda and Sacramento counties with its headquarters located in Oakland, California.

LFCD delivers programs and services from seven locations in more than 35 languages. The organization provides community development, affordable real estate, workforce development, education, and human services that primarily support low-income individuals and families, refugees, immigrants, transitional-age youth, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and other underserved populations.

**Job Summary:** LFCD is looking for a candidate to provide housing support services to the re-entry population, including community outreach efforts to form community collaborations, promote the understanding of the program, and build relationships with funders and partners to increase the number of referrals to the program. The candidate will work closely with onsite operational staff to provide ancillary services as needed. The position also manages participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medi-Cal (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs. The position duties include: outreach recruitment for potential landlords and preparing tenants to place in subsidized housing, case management, providing ongoing support to these individuals, and follow-up and retention services. This position will directly report to the Program Coordinator.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Conduct all program's intake eligibility, verification, obtain all required documents, orientation, assessments, workshops, and peer support coaching
* Build confidence, readiness, and emotional health of participants to address barriers towards stabilizing life and work situations
* Create individual personal goal plans, housing plans, and savings plans; conduct one-on-one or group peer support coaching and financial coaching; assist participants in reaching their personal goals, saving goals, and moving from transitional housing to permanent housing
* Assist clients with providing resources and referral assistance, including mental health counseling, substance abuse counseling, legal assistance, and social adjustment assistance
* Establish and maintain relationships with other service providers, including banks, credit unions, OHA, landlords, and other housing program providers
* Create and manage a landlord's directory for affordable permanent housing placement and support CARE Campus residents with their needs
* Recruit, interview, and negotiate with landlords to assist clients in finding permanent, affordable housing
* Provide landlords with orientations on the project value, goals with target population profile, written agreements, and other technical supports to cultivate, build trust, and maintain business relationships with funders, subcontractor partners, landlords, and other community service providers
* Manage participants enrolled in the Cal-AIM Initiative, providing comprehensive care management that addresses both clinical and non-clinical needs, including housing instability, food insecurity, and other social determinants of health
* Develop and monitor Cal-AIM participant care plans, coordinate with managed care plans and health providers, and ensure participants receive appropriate Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Supports services
* Maintain all program-related documents for monitoring and compliance with federal, state, and local regulations under the project's requirements
* Represent LFCD at local collaborative community meetings, attend all the required training, housing-related meetings, or conferences as assigned
* Attend monthly meetings as needed, participate in "Client Resource Forums", Housing fair, and a visit to the County jail for recruitment
* Maintain case records, statistics, and service records for program reports
* Perform tracking of participants' attendance, input data, daily log, standard case management, and job activities into the database system for record-keeping, and provide follow-up service till they successfully exit the program
* Maintain a thorough understanding of the Cal-AIM program and leverage cross-sector partnerships to support positive housing and health outcomes for participants
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent with a concentration in social work, psychology, sociology, or other related fields preferred
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred
* Knowledge of the Cal-AIM Initiative, including Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and Community Supports, and experience coordinating services across health and social service systems preferred
* Self-starter, ability to work with minimal supervision, and experience working with multiple barriers and the reentry population
* Good written and oral communication skills. Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to multitask. Good analytic skills, critical thinking skills, ability to create accurate and insightful data outcomes and evaluations, and strong Excel, Word, and PowerPoint presentations
* Proven track record in managing and working independently
* Ability to work late or on weekends as needed for activities related to the program

jobs.title: Care Coordinator II, III - Resilient Recovery
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
  
**The required shift for this position is:**  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The Resilient Recovery Program provides youth and adults with substance use and co-occurring mental health services in the form of individual and group counseling and care coordination. This program is committed to working with underserved communities from a variety of backgrounds. We strive to meet the ongoing needs of individuals struggling with mental health issues, substance use disorders, and co-occurring mental health issues.
  
  
Care Coordinators are an important part of the San Mateo County Outpatient Program. Utilizing a trauma informed approach, they are responsible for assessing adult and youth client needs and strengths to collaboratively create treatment plans/problem lists with their clients that support their health and recovery. The care coordinator/counselor will provide individual and group counseling to adults and youth; deliver evidence-based curricula in accordance with program specific requirements. Care Coordinators assists clients in navigating systems of care while providing a supportive treatment environment.
  
  
May work weekends and holidays as needed.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Individual Treatment Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates intakes/orientations, comprehensive assessments, individualized treatment planning, crisis, collateral, case management and individual counseling sessions with clients.
* Offers clinical support and counseling to assist clients in meeting their treatment goals including providing feedback, setting boundaries, and celebrating successes.
* Proactively links clients to both internal and external resources based on their treatment needs and follows up on the progress/status.

**Treatment Setting Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates group counseling sessions and teaches classes on various treatment-related topics.
* Conducts screenings and intake assessments to determine client’s eligibility and ASAM level of care placement.
* Performs crisis intervention and communicates with treatment team as unforeseen situations arise.
* Completes and attends required training and meetings.
* Coordinate discharge planning in collaboration with the rest of the treatment team.
* Comply with certifying agency requirements for registration/certification renewal.
* Plans and facilitates client celebrations and special events.
* Will work one weekend day based on rotating schedule to facilitate the scheduled weekend groups.
* Will work at agency’s main office and in addition to co-location sites which may include schools, community health centers, in-home, and partner agencies.

**Documentation Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborates with each caseload client and other available internal and external resources to develop/maintain treatment plans/problem lists, transition/discharge plans, progress notes and appropriate updates in support of the health and recovery needs of the client.
* Properly documents all individual and group counseling sessions, intake and assessments, completes discharge paperwork and referrals in a timely manner as required by DMC and county.
* Maintains accurate records by entering documentation into various electronic systems for all caseload clients in accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements.
* Will participate in Peer Chart/ Utilization Reviews for preparation of program audits. Will adhere to documentation policies and procedures set forth by Compliance Department.
* Be responsive and proactive in all correspondences with referring parties such as behavioral health providers, probation, social workers, and the Quality Improvement Dept. via treatment status reports, phone calls, faxes, etc.
* Responds to records updates and corrections in a timely manner to ensure documentation compliance and accuracy.
* Will assist in providing written progress reports/narratives to Clinical Program Manager or Directors as requested.

**Productivity and Coverage Responsibilities:**  

* Must meet productivity standards as set forth by the organization, the minimum being 50% productivity.
* Ensure coverage during absences or unplanned events by coordinating with team members and management.
* Adjusts workload as necessary to ensure uninterrupted service delivery, including stepping in to provide support during peak demand times or staff shortages.
* Adheres to the program’s scheduling protocols to maintain appropriate client-to-provider ratios.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, and Experience
  

* High School diploma or equivalent OR associate degree in a related field/
* Must be registered as an Alcohol and Other Drug Counselor or as an SUD Counselor with CA approved certifying agency (CCAPP, CADTP, or CAADE).
* First Aid Certified within 30 days of employment.
* CPR Certified within 30 days of employment.
* 1 year of SUD experience required.

jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager — Corporate & Public Sector
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the Role**

Smarsh is looking for a Manager of Sales Strategy & Operations to be the operating backbone for our Corporate and Public Sector sales segments. You'll own Sales Ops for both segments end to end — strategy, planning, and execution — and act as the primary Ops partner to the VP of Sales, turning data into the narrative and recommendations that drive their business.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you're as comfortable designing a territory model or building a forecast as you are presenting a recommendation to segment leadership. You’ll work closely with a Customer Success Operations counterpart supporting these same segments and help connect the pre- and post-sale operating model. This is an individual contributor role today, with potential to build and lead a team as the segments scale.

### **How will you contribute?**

**Sales strategy & planning**

* Own annual and in-year planning for Corporate and Public Sector: territory design, account segmentation, quota setting, and capacity planning.
* Translate segment strategy into operating plans, priorities, and resourcing decisions in partnership with the VP of Sales and their leadership team.
* Identify risks and opportunities in the business before they show up in bookings, and bring recommendations, not just observations.

**Forecasting, pipeline & revenue cadence**

* Run the forecasting and pipeline management process for both segments: cadence, hygiene, deal inspection, and accuracy.
* Build and maintain the operating rhythm — pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, QBRs — that keeps segment leadership aligned and accountable.
* Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Commissions on deal structuring, quota attainment, and incentive execution for your segments.

**Reporting, analytics & business reviews**

* Build the reporting and dashboards that give a trusted, real-time view of pipeline, forecast, and performance.
* Go beyond status reporting — use cohort, funnel, and productivity analysis to explain what's driving performance and what to do about it.
* Own the analytics behind monthly and quarterly business reviews for Corporate and Public Sector.

**Cross-functional & systems partnership**

* Partner with Enterprise Applications to translate Sales Ops needs into systems requirements, and help prioritize the roadmap for tools these segments depend on (Salesforce, forecasting, sales engagement/intelligence platforms).
* Align closely with the CS Ops partner on these segments to connect new business, renewal, and expansion data and processes.
* Build strong working relationships with Finance, Marketing, and Enterprise Applications, and influence outcomes without formal authority over those teams.

**AI & process innovation**

* Bring an AI-first mindset: identify where AI and automation can improve forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and day-to-day seller productivity for these segments.
* Pilot new tools and approaches proactively rather than waiting to be asked, and scale what works.

### **What will you bring?**

* 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related GTM function, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience with territory design, quota setting, and annual sales planning processes.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce, including reporting and dashboard build.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable building models and pipeline/forecast analysis from scratch, not just reviewing someone else's output.
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and presenting recommendations clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Background in management consulting or investment banking, particularly with an MBA. (Preferred)
* Experience supporting Public Sector or regulated-industry sales motions.(Preferred)
* Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in a Sales Ops context, with a point of view on where AI can change how a sales org operates.(Preferred)
* SQL skills and experience building in PowerBI. (Preferred)

The above salary range represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting.

Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

**About our culture**

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

jobs.title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, Revenue Planning & Analytics
jobs.description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We are looking for a Staff Revenue Operations Manager to help shape how EvenUp plans for and achieves its growth targets. As we scale our go-to-market organization, this person will own the bottoms-up revenue model that connects company-level goals to the underlying assumptions across our Sales and broader GTM teams.

You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to build annual and quarterly plans, evaluate revenue performance, and conduct the strategic analyses that inform decisions around sales capacity, quotas, territories, and resource allocation. This is a highly analytical role that requires both strong modeling skills and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear recommendations.

**Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.**

**What you'll do:**

* **Own revenue planning and forecasting:** Build and maintain EvenUp's bottoms-up GTM model, connecting revenue targets to the underlying drivers of performance, including pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, sales capacity, ramp time, churn, and expansion. Translate company-level growth targets into detailed operating assumptions and forecasts.
* **Lead annual and quarterly planning:** Partner with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to develop annual and quarterly plans across relevant departments. Evaluate what needs to be true across headcount, productivity, conversion, and retention to achieve our goals, identifying key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
* **Drive strategic GTM analysis:** Lead analyses that inform how we structure and allocate our GTM resources, including territory design, customer segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, and sales productivity. Develop recommendations that help leadership make informed tradeoffs as the business scales.
* **Evaluate business performance:** Analyze actual performance against plan, identify the underlying drivers of variances, and assess their implications for future results. Build scenarios and sensitivities to help leadership understand potential outcomes and determine where adjustments are needed.
* **Partner with GTM leadership:** Serve as a strategic thought partner to Revenue Operations and functional leaders, translating complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations. Help leaders pressure-test assumptions, evaluate investment decisions, and prioritize opportunities to improve revenue performance.
* **Strengthen planning methodologies:** Improve the models, assumptions, and analytical approaches used to plan and forecast the business. Partner with Finance, Data, and other cross-functional teams as needed to ensure planning is grounded in reliable data and reflects how EvenUp's GTM organization operates.

**What we look for:**

* **Relevant experience:** 10+ years of experience in Revenue Planning & Analytics, GTM Strategy & Planning, Strategic Finance, Sales Finance, Revenue Operations, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
* **Revenue modeling expertise:** You have built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast, sales capacity model, or comparable operating model. You understand how assumptions around pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, ramp time, churn, and expansion translate into business outcomes.
* **Strong analytical and quantitative skills:** You can build models from scratch, evaluate scenarios, pressure-test assumptions, and break down complex business questions into structured analyses. You are comfortable working with large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* **GTM and SaaS business acumen:** You understand the drivers of revenue growth in a recurring-revenue business and how decisions around sales capacity, territory design, segmentation, quotas, and productivity affect performance.
* **Strategic problem-solving:** You can identify the right questions to investigate, determine what the data needs to show, and develop recommendations that help leaders make decisions about planning, resource allocation, and GTM strategy.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** You communicate analytical findings clearly and can work directly with senior stakeholders to challenge assumptions, align on plans, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
* **Ownership and execution:** You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, managing ambiguous problems independently, and building planning models and processes that can evolve as the business scales.

**Benefits & Perks:**

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
* Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
* 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
* Paid parental leave.
* A local in-person meet-up program.
* Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

*(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)*

jobs.title: Manager, Business Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
### **Description**

**Schedule: M-F 40 hours/week**

Candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the communities served by Travis Credit Union, which include the following counties: Alameda, Colusa, Contra Costa, Merced, Napa, Placer, Sacramento, San Joaquin, Solano, Sonoma, Stanislaus, and Yolo. For hybrid and remote roles, candidates are still required to reside within a commutable distance of our corporate headquarters in Vacaville, California.

*We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas for this position. Candidates must have current authorization to work in the U.S. (no sponsorship available).*

**Summary:** The Business Operations & Strategy management role is a pivotal leadership role responsible for overseeing the strategic direction and oversight of the operational performance for the Contact Center. This role blends operational management with strategic planning to ensure exceptional member service and efficient workflows are delivered on while in alignment with organizational goals. This role drives enterprise-level initiatives, influences policy decisions, and leads innovation across service channels to enhance efficiency, scalability, and member experience.

**Profile:**

* Leads, trains, evaluates, coaches, and professionally develops and motivates staff to attain department goals. Sets and monitors performance goals. Promotes a work environment that encourages involvement, initiative and teamwork.
* Leads leadership development plans, providing mentorship, succession planning, and career growth opportunities for team members.
* Fosters a high-performing, collaborative culture that promotes innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Analyzes complex operational and financial data to identify trends, forecast performance, and provide actionable insights to senior leadership.
* Leads enterprise-level, cross-functional projects, making decisions on scope, timelines, and resource allocation while ensuring stakeholder alignment.
* Champions process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and member experience, evaluating ROI and risk impact before implementation.
* Communicates strategies, insights and recommendations effectively to executives, teams, and stakeholders to influence organizational decision-making.
* Develops and executes strategic plans aligned with credit union goals and member needs, while monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess progress and ensure achievement of strategic objectives.
* Establishes compliance frameworks and ensures adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies across all operational initiatives.
* Defines and implements technology strategies to support digital transformation, exercising discretion in vendor selection and technology investments.

  

Not all functions/tasks are listed above; however, those listed are considered essential.

**Skills:**

* Proven leadership experience managing teams in a high-volume, member-facing environment.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Experience with workforce management systems and contact center technologies.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Skilled in managing cross-functional projects, timelines, budgets, and communications.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change initiatives and support teams through transitions.
* Strategic thinker with a track record of driving innovation and continuous improvement.

  

**Reporting and Experience:**

jobs.title: Global Supply Chain Operations Manager

Meta is seeking a Global Supply Chain Operations Manager to drive end-to-end supply chain execution for hardware programs supporting Meta's portfolio of consumer devices, data center infrastructure, and emerging technologies including virtual reality, augmented reality, and wearable platforms. In this role, you will lead cross-functional efforts to manage supplier ecosystems, ensure component supply continuity, and align sourcing strategies with product development and manufacturing timelines across complex, high-volume global programs.  
  
  

### **Global Supply Chain Operations Manager Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute commodity strategies for technically complex components including custom silicon, electromechanical assemblies, optical modules, display systems, and structural hardware used across Meta's hardware product lines
* Lead supplier engagement activities including demand versus supply assessments, manufacturing capability audits, capacity planning, and risk evaluations across global supply chains
* Partner with hardware engineering, new product introduction, and manufacturing operations teams to influence component architecture decisions and design-for-manufacturability trade-offs during early product development stages
* Establish supplier performance management frameworks including scorecards, structured business reviews, and corrective action plans tied to quality, delivery, cost, and responsiveness metrics
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks arising from geopolitical factors, single-source dependencies, commodity market volatility, and supplier financial instability
* Drive multi-source supply strategies and qualification of alternate suppliers to improve supply chain resilience across critical component categories
* Collaborate with demand planning, logistics, and operations teams to align supplier capacity commitments and lead time targets with product ramp schedules and volume forecasts
* Develop and communicate commodity roadmaps and supply chain strategies to cross-functional partners and organizational leadership, influencing sourcing decisions at scale
* Support new product introduction programs by managing supplier ramp readiness, coordinating first article inspections, and tracking production validation milestones
* Leverage data analytics and supply chain platforms to monitor spend, track supplier performance trends, and surface actionable insights for continuous improvement

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in technical sourcing, commodity management, or supply chain operations within the hardware manufacturing industry
* Experience leading end-to-end supply chain execution for technically complex components, including supplier selection, negotiation, qualification, and lifecycle management
* Experience conducting manufacturing capability assessments, process audits, and supplier risk evaluations for high-volume production programs
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, quality engineering, new product introduction, and finance teams to align sourcing decisions with product and business requirements
* Experience developing and presenting commodity strategies, supply risk analyses, and supplier performance reports to cross-functional stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with responsible sourcing standards or supplier sustainability assessment frameworks applicable to global hardware supply chains
* Experience managing supply chains for consumer electronics or wearable hardware products, including components such as optical systems, display modules, or custom silicon
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize supply chain workflows and drive measurable impact such as efficiency gains, lead time reduction, or risk identification improvements
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. **JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for the direct or indirect oversight and coordination of all operational functions in the Bay Area (San Jose and Oakland) grouping, resulting in a well-functioning, compliant operational environment. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison for HQ Regional Functional Leads including Supply Chain Advisor (SCA), Regional Safety & Security Director (RSSD), Regional IT Director (RITD) and Global Facilities Director (GFD). This position reports to the Executive Director and oversees the Operations staff in both offices. This position is based in either San Jose or Oakland, with regular weekly onsite presence within both offices.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Safety & Security—S&S:**

* Oversee regional S&S matters.
* Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of all office S&S documentation.
* Organize all-staff S&S meetings at office or program site.
* Ensure that a minimum of one emergency evacuation is exercised at office or program site level per year and other appropriate trainings informed by Security Risk Assessment findings.
* Cascade HQ and/or office security warnings and advisories to staff, interns, and volunteers as needed.
* Report all S&S incidents involving covered persons in accordance with established protocols.
* Coordinate immediate incident management including filing police reports.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other S&S actors or stakeholders, including but not limited to community organizations and partners, authorities, security and rescue services, and property owners.
* Assist in the development of office-specific S&S onboarding materials, ensuring the provision of S&S briefings to new staff and covered persons.

**Supply Chain—SC:**

* Serve as the region’s primary focal point for procurement, asset and inventory management, in-kind donations tracking and reporting, vehicle fleet management and transportation, and warehousing in accordance with established organizational and donor requirements.
* Lead the bidding process, including request for quotation process, request for proposal process, tender evaluation, and facilitating procurement committee functioning.
* Manage relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Maintain up-to-date supplier and service provider records. Maintain asset register and inventory lists of purchased and donated items. Establish and manage inventory control for office supplies, stationery, and other consumables. In collaboration with the Finance Manager, ensure inventories reconcile with financial reports.
* Support program teams in meeting their match goals.
* Ensure policy compliance for the fleet of IRC-owned vehicles and oversee their maintenance and usage.
* Working with HQ Supply Chain to maintain IRC policy at all the times.
* Control and maintain the IRC policy through the PO system in Integra.

**Facilities Management:**

* Manage the region’s office and equipment leases, coordinate repairs and improvements with property managers, and lead the procurement of office equipment.
* Coordinate the allocation of workspaces and support related employee lifecycle needs such as building access.
* Support smooth functioning of office infrastructure including communications equipment and services.
* Assist with planning and coordinating office events and meetings.
* Responsible for coordinating on- and off-site storage needs.
* Maintain NorCal’s status with all counties related to annual property’s tax along with exemption status.

**Information Technology—IT:**

* Oversee grouping IT and communications infrastructure, hardware and software matters.
* Educate staff about IT support resources, including appropriate channels for incident reporting.
* Work with regional and HQ IT team to address any internet or telecommunications service disruptions, liaising with local internet and telecommunications service providers.
* Escalate any unresolved incidents or larger-scale IT projects (such as office moves or expansion) as needed.
* Ensure compliance with IT protocols, policies, and procedures including information security policy, IT procurement and asset management policy, acceptable use of IT resources policy, and new software procurement protocols.

**Other Duties**

* Provide mentorship and supervision to Operations staff, including leading team meetings, individual supervision and coaching, and conducting goal setting, and performance reviews.
* Approve Integra vendor creations and invoice journals.
* Coordinate with the Finance Director to manage administrative expenses and reports.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Working Relationships:**

* **Position reports to:** Executive Director
* **Position directly supervises:** Front Desk staff, Operations staff

**Job Requirements:**

* Undergraduate degree in business, non-profit management, public administration, or others related field preferred
* At least five years of related professional experience; preferably with refugee services and in a non-profit or social service environment
* Experience supervising staff preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work with deadlines and lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

jobs.title: Supply Chain & Operations Manager (North America)
jobs.description:
**About UnitX**
---------------

UnitX is building the AI-powered eyes and brain for autonomous manufacturing. Our machine-vision platform helps manufacturers detect complex defects, automate inspection, and improve production quality in applications where conventional vision systems fall short.

We are expanding into emerging, high-growth markets—including AI data-center infrastructure and next-generation AI hardware—and are looking for a business development leader to help establish UnitX as a strategic partner to the companies defining these industries.

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain & Operations Manager to own how hardware moves through UnitX in North America. You'll make sure every part we buy arrives on time, every system we ship is right the first time, and every dollar and asset is accounted for. You'll work closely with Engineering, Field Deployment, Finance and Sales, and you'll be comfortable both negotiating with vendors and testing hardware at the bench.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Run domestic and international receiving and shipping for customer orders and internal hardware/software, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs documents and export compliance
* Bench-test incoming and outgoing hardware (power-on, imaging, camera/lens checks); triage failures with Engineering before shipment
* Own procurement for hardware (GPUs, industrial PCs, cameras, lenses, cables, lighting) and software licenses, from quotes and POs through approvals, renewals and cost tracking
* Manage vendor performance: track lead times and on-time delivery, resolve late or defective shipments and keep an approved vendor list
* Build and run inventory and asset management: system of record, cycle counts, reconciliation, asset tagging and RMAs
* Manage import and export compliance: classify products (HTS, ECCN), calculate duties, tariffs and landed cost, work with customs brokers, file export documents and keep records audit-ready
* Own the monthly operations dashboard (on-time delivery, shipment errors, spend vs budget, inventory accuracy); write and maintain SOPs; work with Sales and Field teams on demand and delivery planning; lead process improvement across NA operations
* Run the office, warehouse and lab space: layout, security, safety and EHS compliance, office supplies, facility vendors; Set up laptops and accounts, manage license seats, handle first-line hardware and network issues as needed

**What you'll bring**
=====================

* 5+ years in supply chain, operations or procurement at a hardware company
* Comfort assembling, powering on and troubleshooting computers, GPUs, cameras and cabling
* Hands-on experience shipping high-value products domestically and internationally (Incoterms, HTS codes, commercial invoices, export controls)
* Working knowledge of import and export duties and customs: tariff classification, duty and tariff impacts, customs broker management
* A record of buying both hardware and software licenses, including negotiating price and lead time
* Experience owning inventory and asset tracking in an ERP or inventory system (NetSuite, Odoo or similar) with high count accuracy
* Strong organization and follow-through; you like clean data and clear processes
* Able to work on-site in our Milpitas office, 5 days a week

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience at a machine vision, industrial automation, robotics or AI hardware company
* Experience building operations processes from scratch at a startup
* Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers
* Bilingual in Mandarin is a plus

==================

This role offers the opportunity to accelerate human productivity through robotics in manufacturing. You get to define how a differentiated AI-vision platform enters some of the world’s fastest-growing and most strategically important manufacturing markets. You will work directly with company leadership, influence product and market strategy, and build relationships that can become significant global accounts.

The Program Manager (PM) Assistant will support Operations Program Managers (OPMs) in the day-to-day program execution, cross-functional coordination, data tracking, and project follow-up.  
This role will support fast-paced AI server and New Product Introduction (NPI) manufacturing programs, working closely with Program Management, Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and other functional teams. Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or related credentials

jobs.title: Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
LGTC Group, P.C. is a CARF-accredited, multi-site behavioral health organization providing evidence-based mental health services across outpatient, IOP, PHP, and residential levels of care throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We serve children, adolescents, and adults across Santa Clara County and beyond, with a multidisciplinary team committed to individualized, compassionate treatment that promotes lasting recovery and well-being.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator** is a pivotal operational role responsible for the day-to-day management of LGTC's outpatient therapy services across multiple locations. This position sits at the intersection of clinical operations and administrative systems — ensuring seamless scheduling, EHR compliance, credentialing coordination, regulatory adherence, and continuity of care for an active outpatient caseload.

The ideal candidate is operationally precise, comfortable with data, and able to work proactively across clinical, administrative, and leadership teams without requiring close supervision. Prior experience in behavioral health or healthcare operations is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Scheduling & Calendar Management**

* Coordinate and maintain therapist calendars across all outpatient locations
* Manage scheduling for Group Therapy, Social Labs, and therapy provision at satellite locations (Oakland, Roseville, Willow St., San Bruno)

**EHR Administration & Compliance**

* Audit and oversee documentation completion in the electronic health record (EHR)
* Provide EHR technical support to clinical staff — including couples therapy charting, treatment plan templates, documentation workflows, and consent forms for specialized services (couples therapy agreements, MFT video recording, KAP meet-and-greet consents)
* Ensure form forwarding rules are correctly configured for associates and clinical supervisors
* Set up private pay agreements in EHR for clients assigned to interns
* Maintain website accuracy for associate therapist listings and supervisor information

**Credentialing & Staff Transitions**

* Proactively communicate associate therapist licensure status changes to initiate credentialing without delay
* Coordinate client coverage options during credentialing periods
* Ensure adherence to therapist offboarding and client transfer protocols to maintain continuity of care

**Case Management & Clinical Support**

* Provide ongoing case management for enrolled outpatient clients
* Support high-acuity cases in collaboration with clinical staff

**Data, Metrics & Reporting**

* Prepare reports and track program metrics including demand, capacity, and census
* Track therapist productivity and calculate bonuses
* Work with Informatics lead to track Kaiser MBC stats — conversion rates and time to intake/admission
* Track and follow up on therapist complaint inquiry forms
* Identify therapist hiring needs and growth opportunities based on demand data (in-person, virtual, specific modalities)

**Operations & Site Management**

* Coordinate multi-site furniture procurement and site setup
* Track site-level expense reports for therapy-related purchases across all locations
* Maintain regulatory and policy compliance documentation for CARF through SharePoint
* Identify and support process improvement initiatives

**Meetings & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Facilitate and attend psychotherapist monthly and quarterly meetings
* Attend Ketamine Assisted Psychotherapy-specific weekly meetings
* Coordinate across departments and disciplines to support seamless outpatient operations
* Support staff training and onboarding

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Master's degree preferred in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Psychology, or a related field
* Relevant behavioral health operations experience may substitute for advanced degree

**Core Competencies**

* **Operational precision** — manages complex, multi-site scheduling, documentation audits, and compliance workflows simultaneously without dropping details
* **Clinical operations fluency** — understands the intersection of clinical practice and administrative systems; supports EHR workflows, credentialing timelines, and continuity of care protocols independently
* **Proactive communication** — anticipates downstream impacts (licensure changes, offboarding, site gaps) and initiates coordination before problems surface
* **Data orientation** — tracks productivity metrics, census data, conversion rates, and bonus calculations; translates operational data into actionable recommendations
* **Cross-functional collaboration** — effective working across clinical, administrative, contracting, and leadership teams across multiple locations
* **Judgment under ambiguity** — able to support high-acuity cases and process improvement initiatives with minimal direction

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, and holidays)
* CEU/professional development support
* Collaborative, mission-driven work environment within a CARF-accredited organization

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

**Pay:** Starting at $30 per hour, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Work Location:** In person — San Jose

*LGTC Group, P.C. is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.*

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Consultant
jobs.description:
**Position Overview :**
  
Our client in San Jose, CA, is seeking a Quality Assurance Consultant for a three-month engagement to support manufacturing compliance initiatives and remediation activities in preparation for an anticipated FDA inspection in early 2027.

The consultant will focus on addressing manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and quality findings identified through internal facility and manufacturing line audits. Responsibilities may also include reviewing GMP batch records, evaluating documentation for compliance, and supporting efforts to ensure manufacturing operations are inspection-ready as the company advances toward a Biologics License Application (BLA).

The ideal candidate brings experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing quality, deviation investigations, CAPA management.  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Review and address manufacturing deviations and CAPAs identified through internal audits of the facility and manufacturing operations.
* Support root cause investigations, develop corrective and preventive action plans, and assist with timely resolution of outstanding quality issues.
* Evaluate manufacturing processes and documentation to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for remediation.
* Review GMP batch production records for completeness, accuracy, adherence to procedures, and compliance with applicable quality requirements.
* Support the development, execution, and documentation of corrective actions to strengthen compliance.
* Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and ensure effective implementation of remediation activities.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and inspection-ready documentation of investigations, CAPAs, and related quality activities.
* Support inspection-readiness initiatives in anticipation of an FDA inspection expected between February and April 2027.
* Contribute to quality and compliance activities supporting the company's progress toward a BLA submission.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Compliance, or Manufacturing Quality within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Hands-on experience investigating manufacturing deviations and managing CAPAs in a GMP-regulated environment.
* Experience reviewing batch records and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong investigation, documentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize remediation activities, and deliver results within a defined contract period.

jobs.description:
Our client is an early-stage healthcare and life sciences company offering highly individualized treatments. They are hiring Patient Case Managers to guide patients and their families through a complex, personalized care journey from first enquiry to follow-up. You will help shape how the company supports patients, not just follow a process someone else wrote.

What you'll do

* **Be the main point of contact** for your group of patients, their families and their physicians through regular emails and video calls, guiding each patient from first enquiry and sign-up through eligibility review, treatment preparation and delivery, and follow-up.
* **Own each patient's journey.** Collect medical data for eligibility screening, request records, manage consent paperwork and keep every step on its agreed timeline.
* **Collaborate with senior leadership and the medical and scientific teams.** Answer non-clinical questions directly and escalate clinical questions promptly through the established pathway.
* **Coordinate samples end to end.** Arrange collection and shipping with physicians, labs and other external partners, and track every sample through to results.
* **Lead sensitive conversations** about risks, costs, billing and financial aid with compassion and discretion, and arrange practical support such as travel and scheduling.
* **Build the foundations.** Create and maintain patient trackers and accurate, confidential records, and help formalize the end-to-end patient process. Over time, you may train and manage new case managers while keeping your own patient group.

What we're looking for

**Must-haves**

* Direct patient-facing or client-facing coordination experience, such as nurse navigation, patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support
* A proven record of handling sensitive, difficult conversations directly with patients and families, beyond administrative work behind the scenes
* Compassionate communication in distressing situations
* Roughly 2-7 years of relevant experience (strong candidates with less will be considered)
* Comfort managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across multiple external parties, with a track record of keeping every case moving and nothing dropped
* Ability to work hybrid in San Francisco, 3-4 days per week
* A degree, with a strong academic background

**Nice-to-haves**

* Oncology or other serious-illness experience
* A medical or nursing background, or nurse navigator experience
* Familiarity with HIPAA, GCP and specimen handling or chain of custody
* Experience with expanded-access, personalized or cell-based therapy programs, or clinical-trial enrolment
* Experience building processes from scratch

Pay: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94114

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.

Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It's a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.

We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

**Your role:**

Global Relay is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager to join our growing team in San Francisco. In this role you will own a portfolio of large, complex, and high-growth accounts across the financial services and regulated tech sectors — industries where Global Relay is deeply embedded. You will serve as a trusted strategic advisor, driving retention and expansion by aligning our platform capabilities to your customers' evolving compliance, communications, and data-management priorities.

This is a high-visibility, quota-carrying role with direct impact on net revenue retention. You will engage C-suite and senior stakeholders in Executive Business Reviews, orchestrate cross-functional delivery teams, and lead sophisticated renewal negotiations — all within one of the most demanding regulatory environments in enterprise SaaS.

**Your responsibilities:**

**Account Strategy & Management**

* Build and own long-term account plans aligned to C-suite and senior leadership priorities across a defined book of large-cap and high-growth accounts.
* Develop trusted-advisor relationships with IT Directors, Compliance Managers, and business unit leaders — influencing strategic decisions and securing multi-year partnerships.
* Lead quarterly and annual Executive Business Reviews, using platform usage data, adoption metrics, and industry benchmarks to demonstrate and expand value.
* Orchestrate cross-functional customer engagements spanning Sales, Enterprise Services, Product, and Support to resolve complex issues and improve time-to-value.

**Revenue Retention & Growth**

* Own the full renewal lifecycle — from early risk identification through RFP management and procurement-level negotiation — with accountability for gross and net revenue retention targets.
* Proactively identify and qualify cross-sell and upsell opportunities in partnership with Sales, aligning expansion to documented customer goals and strategic roadmap.
* Partner with Global Relay's Client Services teams to drive platform adoption, increase product utilization depth, and surface expansion signals from usage data.
* Maintain accurate pipeline, health scores, and renewal forecasts in Salesforce; contribute to team NRR and expansion reporting.

**Team Enablement & Thought Leadership**

* Coach and mentor CSMs and CSRs on renewal negotiation, objection handling, EBR facilitation, and account planning best practices.
* Contribute to playbook development, sharing repeatable frameworks for account segmentation, risk management, and executive engagement.
* Represent the voice of the customer internally — advocating for product enhancements and influencing roadmap priorities based on portfolio-level patterns.

**About you:**

* 6+ years of experience in a SaaS environment in Customer Success, enterprise account management, or strategic sales — with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding NRR and expansion targets.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts ($500K+ ARR) in regulated industries such as financial services, legal, or healthcare tech is strongly preferred.
* Skilled negotiator with the ability to lead commercial conversations through procurement and legal review cycles without losing momentum or margin.
* Fluent communicator — able to tailor messaging from technical detail to executive narrative across written, verbal, and formal presentation formats.
* Experienced in leading cross-functional teams and influencing outcomes without formal authority.
* Proficiency in Salesforce or comparable CRM for pipeline management, health scoring, and forecasting; comfort with CS platforms (Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero) is a plus.
* Familiarity with data archiving, compliance communications, or financial services regulatory frameworks (FINRA, SEC, MiFID II) is a meaningful differentiator — not a requirement.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.

**What you can expect:**

At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.

Global Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.

To learn more about our business, culture, and community involvement, visit www.globalrelay.com.

WeBox is the leading intelligent marketplace delivering personalized group orders.

WeBox is driven by three core principles: customers first, value the strivers, and build with partners.

**Our Mission**  
Deliver Happiness

**Our Vision**  
By 2032, we will achieve $1 billion in revenue by leveraging technology to become a leading provider of intelligent and sustainable solutions for group orders.

**Job Summary**  
WeBox is seeking an experienced, customer-focused, and results-driven **Manager of Customer Success** to lead and develop our Customer Success team.

In this role, you will be responsible for **managing the Customer Success team, driving accountability toward team and individual goals, and ensuring customers receive a consistently high level of service and support**. You will coach and guide team members on the right processes, establish clear expectations, monitor performance and customer outcomes, and step in to support escalations or complex account situations when needed.

You will work closely with Sales, Operations, and other internal teams to strengthen customer retention, grow existing accounts, improve Customer Success processes, and ensure successful execution across the customer lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is a **hands-on leader with strong Customer Success or Account Management experience who knows how to coach a team, establish scalable processes, and drive measurable results in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.**

**Core Responsibilities**

* Lead, manage, and develop the Customer Success team, providing ongoing coaching, guidance, and support
* Establish clear team goals, priorities, expectations, and processes to drive consistent execution
* Monitor individual and team performance to ensure Customer Success goals and KPIs are being achieved
* Hold team members accountable for customer retention, account growth, client engagement, and overall customer experience
* Guide Customer Success team members toward the correct processes and best practices for managing customer accounts
* Coach team members on client communication, relationship management, QBRs, account strategy, renewals, retention, and growth opportunities
* Identify performance gaps and provide clear, actionable coaching to improve results
* Develop and improve Customer Success processes, workflows, playbooks, and operating standards as the team scales
* Oversee key customer accounts and provide strategic guidance on complex, high-value, or at-risk accounts
* Proactively identify customer risks, trends, and opportunities using customer and operational data
* Partner with Sales and Operations to ensure a smooth transition from customer acquisition through onboarding and ongoing account management
* Support the team in resolving escalated customer issues and ensure appropriate follow-through
* Drive strategies to improve customer retention, satisfaction, engagement, and account growth
* Ensure the team maintains regular client touchpoints, including virtual meetings, onsite visits, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)
* Support client networking events, appreciation initiatives, and engagement programs to strengthen customer relationships
* Provide leadership with visibility into Customer Success performance, key risks, customer feedback, and growth opportunities

**Key Skills**

* Strong people leadership, coaching, and team development skills
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency
* Ability to set clear expectations and hold a team accountable for results
* Customer-first mindset with strong relationship-building skills
* Data-driven approach to measuring performance and identifying opportunities
* Strong understanding of customer retention, account management, and account growth
* Ability to develop structured, repeatable Customer Success processes
* Clear and strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable providing direct, constructive feedback and coaching
* Proactive, hands-on leadership style with a willingness to step in when needed
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Operations, and other business functions
* Adaptable and comfortable building processes in an evolving, high-growth organization

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, or a related field
* Masters of relevant degree or MBA preferred
* **5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Client Success role**
* **2+ years of experience leading, managing, or coaching a Customer Success or Account Management team**
* Demonstrated experience driving customer retention, account growth, or other Customer Success KPIs
* Experience establishing and improving Customer Success processes, workflows, and best practices
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to evaluate team and customer performance
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, motivate, and hold team members accountable
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stay organized under pressure and tight deadlines
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to customer escalations
* Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Operations, and other internal teams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset
* Experience in a startup or high-growth environment preferred
