jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.

By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.

This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You'll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.

Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.

**This is a hybrid role based in New York and San Francisco.**

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall's value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer's unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall's product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  

### **Qualifications:**

* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

DDN is seeking a **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** to work directly with strategic enterprise and AI/ML customers, deploying, integrating, and optimizing DDN systems in production environments.  
As an TAM, you will serve as the hands-on technical lead responsible for ensuring the success, reliability, and performance of large-scale, globally distributed HPC and AI infrastructure. You’ll act as the bridge between DDN Engineering and customer Site Reliability/Operations teams, translating complex requirements into tested, automated, and maintainable solutions. You will also collaborate with sales and sales engineering teams to develop and optimize offerings to ensure customer success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and optimize DDN storage and data management systems in customer environments.
* Partner with customer Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Operations teams to ensure production performance, availability, and scalability.
* Partner with DDN Sales and Sales Engineering teams to deliver solutions that add value to our customer environments
* Automate system monitoring, deployment, and configuration tasks using scripts and DevOps tooling.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across compute, storage, and networking layers.
* Develop and maintain deployment documentation, procedures, and best practices.
* Work with DDN Engineering and Product Management to translate field requirements into product enhancements (RFEs).
* Act as the on-site technical focal point during deployments, upgrades, and critical incidents.
* Lead technical meetings and operational reviews with customer and DDN stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement through feedback loops with Product, Support, and Engineering teams.
* Ensure alignment between deployed configurations and customer strategic roadmaps for HPC, AI, and ML workloads.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 8+ years of hands-on technical experience in systems engineering, deployment, or operations.
* Strong Linux administration background.
* Proven experience deploying and managing large-scale HPC, AI, or ML infrastructure.
* Deep knowledge of parallel file systems (Exascaler, Lustre, or GPFS).
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting InfiniBand and high-performance Ethernet networks.
* Proficiency with DevOps tools and scripting (Python, Bash, Ansible, etc.) for automation and monitoring.
* Familiarity with containers, orchestration (Kubernetes, Slurm), and hybrid/cloud environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interface directly with customer, engineering and executive teams.
* Comfortable working independently in globally distributed environments.
* Willingness to travel as required (up to 25%).
* Ability to lift up to 75 pounds when supporting hardware installations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML workflows, GPU-accelerated computing, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
* Understanding of CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
* Project management or DevOps certification (e.g., PMP, CKA, AWS Solutions Architect) is a plus.

Compensation Range: $128K - $154K

**Own Your Intelligence**

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

**Your Role**
-------------

We are a team of about 60, headquartered in San Francisco, with teammates around the world. The office is where a globally distributed team becomes one team: where researchers and engineers work side by side, where customers and partners visit, and where onsites and offsites bring everyone together. Making that space work well, every day, is not a background task — it shapes how the company feels to work at.

As Office Manager, you will run our SF office day to day and help plan the in-person moments that bring the team together: onsites, offsites, team dinners, and events in San Francisco, New York, and Berlin. You will be office manager, host, planner, and fixer in one. The first big project is our office move, which you will help drive end to end.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role reporting to our Executive Business Partner, fully onsite five days a week. If you like variety, take pride in a space that runs well, and spot what's broken before anyone asks, you'll fit right in.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Office Operations**

* Help drive the office move end to end — vendors, logistics, and onsite needs — as the first priority

* Support purchasing and vendor invoices with the Executive Business Partner

**Onsites, Offsites & Events**

* Help plan and run company onsites and offsites: venues, housing, travel, catering, group activities, and daily onsite operations
* Support logistics for executive leadership offsites, conferences, and customer visits
* Plan happy hours, dinners, celebrations, and events in SF and other cities, including New York and Berlin
* Manage event vendors alongside the Executive Business Partner

**Travel & Executive Support**

* Book and coordinate team travel for offsites, events, and in-office visits
* Support international travelers with logistics such as ESTA and visa invitation letters
* Back up the Executive Business Partner during PTO and peak periods: calendars, travel, expenses, and ad-hoc needs

**Workplace Experience**

* Host guests and shape the in-person experience for visitors, candidates, and customers
* Run employee experience programs, track team birthdays, and help build culture through team events
* Help manage the Shopify store and merch

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3+ years in office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or event coordination, ideally at a fast-growing startup
* Hands-on experience planning multi-day offsites or events for 30+ people
* Fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, and Notion; comfortable with laptops, docks, and conference room tech
* Ridiculously organized, with strong follow-through and attention to detail
* Warm, unflappable, and great with people at every level
* Comfortable with shifting priorities and making the call when no one else is around to make it
* Sound judgment with confidential information

**Bonus:**

-----------------

You will work directly with leadership on a small team with no layers between you and the work, and have real room to grow into workplace operations, events, or people operations as the company scales.

jobs.title: Geriatric Care Manager
jobs.description:
**Compassionate Community Care | San Francisco, CA**  
**$40–$50 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience**  
**Part-time, temporary | November 2026–February 28, 2027**

**Help older adults live safely, comfortably, and with dignity.**

For 25 years, Compassionate Community Care (CCC) has been providing personalized home care and care management in San Francisco. We respect each client’s preferences, independence, and cultural background.

We’re seeking an experienced, compassionate Care Manager who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and helping older adults and families navigate care needs. Most clients live in private homes; a small number live in assisted living or memory care.

**Why Join CCC?**

* Make a meaningful difference in clients’ daily lives.
* Join a caring, collaborative team that values your experience and input.
* Use your professional skills in a temporary, part-time role with generally no after-hours on-call responsibilities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct client intakes and assessments and develop individualized care plans.
* Guide and coach caregivers on clients’ care needs, preferences, and routines.
* Monitor clients’ well-being, recognize changes, and coordinate timely follow-up.
* Coordinate with families, caregivers, healthcare providers, and facility staff to address changing needs and resolve concerns.
* Coordinate hospital discharges and other care transitions.
* Help caregivers and families respond to dementia-related distress and challenging behaviors, including those associated with advanced dementia.
* Help resolve conflicts and navigate sensitive situations with empathy and professionalism.
* Respond calmly to urgent situations and coordinate appropriate assistance.
* Maintain accurate, timely documentation.

**What You Bring**

* A professional background in nursing, social work, or gerontology.
* At least three years of experience working with older adults, including client assessments, care planning, and care coordination.
* Experience supporting people living with dementia, including advanced dementia, using patience, reassurance, and appropriate redirection.
* A kind, respectful approach and strong customer service and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build trust, manage conflict, and find practical solutions with families, caregivers, and care partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to stay calm and prioritize during urgent situations or emergencies.
* Strong organizational skills, reliable follow-through, and comfort using electronic documentation tools.
* Ability to work in person in San Francisco and commit through February 28, 2027.

Experience in home care, home health, hospice, assisted living, memory care, skilled nursing, or geriatric care management is especially valued.

**Schedule and Location**

* 2–3 weekdays per week, 9:00 AM–5:30 PM.
* In-person work at our San Francisco office and client locations.
* After-hours on-call coverage is generally not required. If needed, it will be compensated separately.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief note about your relevant experience and interest in this position. We look forward to hearing from you.

Pay: $40.00 - $50.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Mileage reimbursement

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist - SAGE Dublin**  
$35.00–$45.00/hour (DOE)

Full-time opportunity in Dublin, California

**Schedule:** 4/10s. Schedule flexibility is required to facilitate training across different shifts and departments.

SAGE Veterinary Centers is seeking an experienced Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist (TLDS) to plan, organize, and direct the clinical training and professional development of our Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.

This is a hands-on clinical role for an experienced veterinary professional who enjoys both working on the hospital floor and developing others. The TLDS continues to work as a Veterinary Technician while assessing clinical skills, training new team members, supporting onboarding, and overseeing technician continuing education for the hospital team. The division of time between the floor and training may vary based on the number of new hires, training needs, and other factors, and the specific area of focus is set by hospital leadership and may shift as hospital needs change.

**Why Join SAGE Dublin**

At SAGE Dublin, part of Ethos Veterinary Health, you’ll join one of the San Francisco Bay Area’s most respected specialty and emergency veterinary hospitals. Our team is dedicated to delivering compassionate, collaborative, and advanced veterinary care while utilizing state-of-the-art technology and innovative treatment options. Services include emergency and critical care, urgent care, internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, and surgery, and we are equally committed to fostering a positive, inclusive workplace culture focused on teamwork, learning, and professional development.

**Responsibilities**

* Work hands-on as a Veterinary Technician while serving as a clinical trainer and mentor for Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Assess, train, and develop new team members as a primary focus of the role.
* Facilitate Veterinary Assistant and Veterinary Technician training across all skill levels through direct, hands-on clinical instruction and a train-the-trainer approach.
* Directly train team members in accordance with written hospital protocols.
* Plan and present clinical in-service training and educational sessions.
* Direct and oversee all technician continuing education (CE), both live and online through VetBloom and Talent Unleashed.
* Assign required VetBloom and Talent Unleashed training to all new employees.
* Partner with Clinical Supervisors to facilitate learning and development plans, including direct training and an effective, timely protocol sign-off process.
* Assist with developing, coordinating, and delivering onboarding and role-specific training across hospital departments, including ezyVet training for non-nursing roles and triage-process training for front desk teams, in collaboration with department leadership.
* Track training modules for all technician levels, including clinical competencies and non-clinical compliance training such as Code of Conduct, Handbook sign-offs, and other acknowledgements.
* Provide input into the development, standardization, and sign-off process for technician protocol practicals.
* Provide timely feedback to team members and leadership regarding training progress and development needs.
* Collaborate with the Ethos Clinical Learning & Development team and other TLDS across the Division to ensure updated training is deployed.
* Work with local Medicine and Operations teams and Regional L&D and Event Management teams on agenda planning, speaker identification, and general support of CE events for Ethos Technicians and referring DVM teams.
* Promote an environment conducive to learning and a culture of learning consistent with the Ethos mission, vision, and values.

**Qualifications**

* Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT), Certified Veterinary Technician (CVT), Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT), or equivalent credential required.
* Knowledge of advanced veterinary practices, procedures, and terminology, with strong hands-on technical skills.
* Veterinary Technician Specialist (VTS) credential, including ACVECCT-VTS, is a plus.
* Experience training, mentoring, precepting, or developing Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Ability to confidently perform and teach veterinary clinical skills, including patient assessment and triage, venipuncture, medication and fluid administration, CPR, and patient care.
* Ability to appropriately handle, lift, and restrain dogs and cats, and to stand for long periods of time.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including communicating effectively with technicians and doctors regarding patient needs.
* Strong presentation and coaching skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback to employees at varying levels of clinical experience.
* Ability to multitask and produce quality work while making effective decisions.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple training and development initiatives.
* Ability to work independently with little or no supervision, as well as collaboratively with technicians, veterinarians, hospital leadership, and Learning & Development partners.

* Experience with veterinary electronic medical record systems such as ezyVet and learning management systems preferred.
* Ability to work a flexible 4/10s schedule across different shifts and departments based on hospital training and clinical needs.

-

PATH is seeking candidates passionate about helping others make a positive change in their lives to join our San Jose team as the CalAIM ECM Case Manager at the Evans Lane office.

**ABOUT PATH**  
Since its foundation in 1984, PATH (People Assisting The Homeless) has pioneered bold and effective approaches to assist people experiencing homelessness. PATH operates services throughout California, connecting our clients to a comprehensive continuum of homelessness prevention, street outreach, employment preparation and placement assistance, individualized case management, supportive services, interim housing, and permanent supportive housing.

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  
This role as Care Manager under CalAIM's Enhanced Care Management program will focus on member medical care coordination, assist in navigation of the health care system, and work with other team members to ensure the medical and housing stability of each participant. Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

**Audience Business Analyst**

**San Mateo, CA (Collab)**

In this role you will be an analyst on SIE's Growth, Media, and Omnichannel Marketing team; specifically, as a part of the Audience, Infrastructure, and Measurement (AIM) team. You will play a vital role in shaping and evolving the way we communicate with our consumers. AIM Analysts bring a diverse range of expertise, spanning SQL development and audience strategy to product leadership and process optimization. While AIM analysts have clear areas of expertise, every member of the team has the opportunity to learn and grow new skills outside of their specialty by contributing to all areas of AIM.

  

We are looking to fill a new Audience Business Analyst role on the AIM team, specializing in audience strategy, operations, and activation for our Live Service business. You will further enable our global marketing organization to use our first party data to put the customer first in all our marketing communications. Together as gamer and customer experience advocates, we can show how PlayStation is truly the Best Place to Play!

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with marketing and agency partners across all marketing regions as the subject matter expert on our ecosystem of data to create custom segments and support campaign executions supporting player acquisition, ongoing engagement, and retention
* Advise partners on campaigns, using data-based insights from AIM, marketing analytics, data science models, and consumer research
* Work as part of our AIM SCRUM team to deliver value to audience activation, while also analyzing and employing operational optimizations that bring our operations to scale across all our owned and paid marketing channels
* Manage ad-hoc and automated customer lists to power PlayStation's digital marketing channels globally

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Well-spoken with strong presentation-making skills that effectively present data in a compelling way, both verbal and written, to influence partner strategy

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**

Ramp is looking for ambitious generalists who want to turn difficult customer and business problems into better products and better ways of working.

In Product Operations, you will own a problem space from investigation through execution and measurement. You might uncover why customers abandon a workflow, build an AI tool that removes hours of manual work, or help a product team bring a new capability to customers. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams, combining analytical rigor with the willingness to do the work yourself.

This role is designed for people who want substantial responsibility. You will build customer understanding, product judgment, technical fluency, and the ability to lead across teams. **WHO WE ARE**

HomeRise believes that home has the power to stabilize a person’s life. Built on a simple - but powerful idea called supportive housing, we provide people experiencing homelessness with a place to call home combined with support services, like mental health services and job training, so they can rise up and transform their lives. We organize our residents and supporters to advocate for local and state policies, like affordable housing, to help people still on the streets or at risk of homelessness. Together, we are building a new future for our neighborhoods and the city we love.

**BENEFITS**

**Program Operations Coordinator**

**Position Summary**

Girls on the Run of Greater Sacramento is seeking a highly organized, relationship-focused professional who is passionate about youth development and creating positive experiences for girls, volunteers, and community partners.

The Program Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring Girls on the Run programs are delivered with excellence across the Greater Sacramento region. This position combines program operations, volunteer engagement, and relationship management to support every stage of our seasonal programs. From helping families navigate registration, to supporting volunteer coaches, to partnering with schools and community sites, this team member helps create the systems and relationships that allow our mission to thrive.

Working closely with the Program Lead and Executive Director, the Program Operations Coordinator serves as a key connector between participants, families, coaches, schools, and community partners. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoys building strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic nonprofit environment.

This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

**About the Role**

At Girls on the Run, successful programs are built through a combination of strong relationships and strong systems. This role helps ensure both are in place.

**Support Exceptional Program Delivery**

You will help create a seamless experience for participants and families from registration through the end of each season. This includes maintaining accurate participant information, supporting registration and scholarship processes, communicating with families, and ensuring program logistics are coordinated effectively.

Success in this area means families feel informed and supported, participant information is accurate, and program operations run smoothly throughout the season.

**Foster Meaningful Coach Relationships**

Volunteer coaches are the heart of Girls on the Run. In this role, you will help cultivate a positive experience for coaches by serving as a consistent point of contact, providing timely communication, answering questions, and connecting coaches with the resources they need to be successful.

You will play an important role in supporting coach recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention efforts while helping ensure coaches feel valued, prepared, and connected to our mission.

**Strengthen School and Community Partnerships**

Girls on the Run programs exist because of strong partnerships with schools and community organizations. You will help maintain and strengthen these relationships by serving as a responsive and professional partner to program sites throughout the region.

This includes communicating with school representatives, supporting site registration and planning processes, addressing questions and concerns, and helping identify opportunities to grow and strengthen partnerships over time.

You will help ensure our community partners have a positive experience working with Girls on the Run and understand the impact of the programs they help make possible.

**Manage Program Systems and Data**

As a primary user of the Girls on the Run program management platform, you will help ensure organizational data is accurate, current, and useful for decision-making.

This includes maintaining participant, coach, and site records; managing registration and roster information; generating reports; and supporting data-driven planning efforts. The ideal candidate enjoys creating order, solving problems, and using technology to support organizational success.

**Contribute to Organizational Growth and Continuous Improvement**

As a member of a small and collaborative team, you will have opportunities to contribute ideas, improve processes, and help strengthen the overall effectiveness of the organization.

We are seeking someone who is not only comfortable managing established systems but is also excited to identify new ways to improve efficiency, enhance stakeholder experiences, and support sustainable growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

Successful candidates will:

* Create positive experiences for participants, families, coaches, and site partners.
* Build strong relationships with schools, community organizations, and volunteers.
* Ensure program information and data are accurate, organized, and accessible.
* Communicate proactively and professionally with a variety of stakeholders.
* Anticipate needs and solve problems before they become barriers.
* Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple competing priorities.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and mission-driven work.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Comfort learning and utilizing technology platforms and databases.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and manage sensitive information.
* Commitment to the mission and values of Girls on the Run.
* Reliable transportation for occasional local travel within the Greater Sacramento region.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with schools, youth-serving organizations, or nonprofit programs.
* Experience coordinating volunteers or volunteer-led programs.
* Experience with database, CRM, or registration management systems.
* Knowledge of community outreach, partnership development, or stakeholder engagement.
* Previous experience with Girls on the Run as a participant, coach, volunteer, or supporter.

**Position Details**

**Position Type:** Part-Time (approximately 20-30 hours per week)

**Location:** Hybrid/Remote within the Greater Sacramento region

**Schedule:** Flexible schedule with some evening and occasional wee

jobs.title: Global Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

**What this job involves**

This role provides comprehensive project management and operational support for client's global Transportation Team. You will manage transportation infrastructure projects from initiation through completion, including EV charging installations, site connectivity improvements, and capital planning initiatives. Working across multiple regions (Bay Area, Distributed Offices, India, APAC), you'll coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure transportation projects align with client's standards, budgets, and timelines while enhancing workplace connectivity and user experience.

**Your day-to-day tasks will include:**

* Managing the full lifecycle of transportation infrastructure projects, including procurement, contracting, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout phases
* Conducting site walks and field assessments to identify transportation infrastructure opportunities, safety improvements, and network gaps across client's facilities
* Developing and coordinating annual capital plans and budgets for transportation projects, including project prioritization, spend forecasts, business case development, and go2gate coordination
* Leading quality assurance and coordination for transportation capital projects, reviewing design packages from concept through construction phases to ensure stakeholder buy-in and alignment with transportation scope
* Collaborating with development/site project teams and external partners (WSMs, REDD, EHS, contractors) to ensure client Transportation standards are implemented for tenant improvements and ground-up development projects
* Creating and managing comprehensive project tracking systems and providing stakeholders with consistent progress updates on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk management
* Maintaining Transportation Team tools, documentation, and data in Drive, including checklists, site walk punch lists, project guides, and departmental data validation for strategic planning

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Urban Planning, or related field
* 5+ years of project management experience managing capital infrastructure projects from initiation through closeout
* Proven experience managing project budgets, schedules, quality control, and risk management for construction or infrastructure projects
* Strong knowledge of construction design phases (conceptual, schematic, design development, construction documentation) and coordination processes
* Demonstrated ability to conduct RFPs, bid evaluations, vendor selection, and manage procurement/contracting processes
* Proficiency with project management tools and tracking systems, with ability to provide executive-level reporting and transparency
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and external partners simultaneously

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or similar project management certification
* Experience with transportation infrastructure projects, including EV charging installation, campus connectivity, or transit-oriented development
* Familiarity with capital planning processes, including business case development and financial forecasting for large-scale projects
* Knowledge of permitting processes and coordination with design/construction teams for implementation
* Experience working in corporate real estate, workplace services, or facilities management environments supporting large technology companies
* Background in conducting site assessments, operational analysis, and identifying infrastructure improvement opportunities
* Strong technical writing skills for project documentation, guides, and process standardization

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

**Expected compensation for this position:**

  
115,000.00 – 128,000.00 USD per year

*Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.*

Remote –San Francisco, CA

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Commercial Strategy & Innovation
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At **BGBx**, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Project Manager, Commercial Strategy & Innovation will serve as a strategic and operational partner to the Chief of Commercial Strategy & Innovation. This role will bring structure, organization, and proactive follow-through to cross-BGBx growth efforts across Consulting, Communications, Medical Communications, Payer, Data, AI, and Technology. This role will coordinate the people, materials, decisions, and follow-through required to move integrated client solutions and cross-planning forward. This is a hands-on senior project manager and strategic operations role that combines account planning, meeting and calendar management, pipeline coordination, leadership preparation, and cross-functional execution.

**R****esponsibilities**

* Coordinate cross-BGBx account planning for priority pharmaceutical clients, including top-to-top meetings, QBRs, client touchpoints, follow-ups, and cross-planning.
* Manage the head of Commercial Strategy & Innovation's calendar and the logistics for key leadership and client activities, using business context to prioritize time, ensure the right participants are included, prepare, agendas and materials, and meetings drive to clear decisions and next steps.
* Maintain a forward-looking view of account priorities, client milestones, proposal deadlines, leadership meetings, and cross-solving activity.
* Track the enterprise pipeline, account plans, opportunity stages, owners, next actions, follow-ups, and available revenue attribution across priority accounts; maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue decisions
* Proactively identify gaps, conflicts, stalled opportunities, missing owners, and decisions that require escalation.
* Build a working understanding of BGBx's capabilities and know which relationship executives, capability experts, solution leads, and delivery teams to pull in, and when, based on client needs and opportunity requirements. Support IxI and Commercial Strategy revenue BLT reporting by coordinating inputs from cross-functional teams, tracking opportunities, owners, next steps, and available revenue attribution, and helping maintain visibility and accountability without owning revenue targets, revenue decisions, or attribution.
* Prepare internal stakeholders for strategic meetings by developing agendas, briefing materials, late-breaking account updates, presentations, and support stakeholders with recommended next steps and follow-through.
* Support the execution and coordination of repeatable account-planning tools, proposal processes, handoff workflows, governance models, and performance-tracking systems.
* Coordinate follow-through after meetings and governance forums, ensuring that commitments are documented, owners are clear, and actions progress to completion.

**What makes the role distinctive**

* This role sits at the intersection of strategic project management and execution. The successful candidate will help BGBx leaders make better use of their time, stay aligned across divisions, and turn cross-BGBx conversations into organized, accountable action
* The role is well suited to a highly organized, proactive, and strategic project manager who is comfortable managing details while understanding the broader business objective. This person should be able to move between calendar coordination, pipeline tracking, senior leadership preparation, executive content development, and cross-functional problem-solving.

**Ideal candidate profile**

* Strong organizational and project-management skills, with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
* Ready to dive in, roll-up-sleeves, diligent, real-time senior meeting mapping, scheduling and actions post client meetings
* Proactive working style, with the judgment to anticipate needs, surface issues, and move work forward without constant direction.
* Strategic thinker who can connect individual meetings and opportunities to broader account and enterprise-growth objectives.
* Comfortable working across senior leaders, client teams, and multiple BGBx practice areas.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to draft, synthesize, and refine executive-ready presentations, briefing materials, account updates and other content
* 5 years of experience in Project management, strategic operations, account management, or a related field with demonstrated independence in complex, senior stakeholder environments
* An MBA or equivalent business experience is preferred.

**Salary Range:** $90,000 - $120,000

BGBx is headquartered in New York City, and the salary range listed reflects the expected base compensation for this role in the New York City metropolitan area. **This position may be performed remotely within the United States.** For candidates located outside the New York City area, compensation will be adjusted to reflect the applicable market for the employee's primary work location. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

**What We Offer**

jobs.description:

**Job Summary**

Responsible for managing complex and high-impact projects within the organization, ensuring successful delivery on time, within scope, and on budget. This role involves leading cross-functional teams, developing and executing comprehensive project plans, and managing significant project risks and issues. Will play a key role in strategic planning, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement, contributing to the overall success and efficiency of major organizational initiatives.

**Job Duties**

* Develop and implement detailed project plans for complex projects, including defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines. Ensure the project plan addresses all critical elements and aligns with organizational goals.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams, including internal staff and external partners. Provide direction, support, and motivation to team members to ensure successful project execution and achievement of project goals.
* Serve as the principal point of contact for key stakeholders, including senior management and external partners. Communicate project status, risks, and issues effectively, and facilitate regular meetings to ensure alignment and address concerns.
* Identify, assess, and manage complex project risks and issues. Develop and implement effective risk mitigation strategies and solutions to address potential challenges and ensure project success.
* Ensure that project deliverables meet the highest quality standards and align with project requirements. Implement and oversee quality control processes to maintain or exceed expected outcomes.
* Manage significant changes to project scope, schedules, and resources. Document and communicate changes clearly to stakeholders, adjusting project plans and strategies as needed to accommodate evolving requirements.
* Maintain detailed project documentation, including project plans, status reports, risk assessments, and change logs. Prepare and present comprehensive project performance reports to senior management and other key stakeholders.
* Evaluate and enhance project management processes and practices. Apply industry best practices and lessons learned to improve project execution and overall project management effectiveness.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or educational experience in related field preferred, or relevant work experience.
* 4-6 years of experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale project budgets, timelines, and resources.
* Proficiency in advanced project management tools and methodologies, including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches.
* Experience managing projects in specific industries relevant to the organization, such as IT, engineering, or finance, with a focus on complex or enterprise-level projects.
* Experience with strategic planning and execution of high-profile projects that have significant organizational impact.
* Background in process improvement and implementation of best practices in project management.
* Deep understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and tools.
* Expertise in advanced project management software and tools for planning, tracking, and reporting.
* Ability to manage substantial budgets, complex schedules, and large resource allocations.
* Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and guide project teams through complex challenges.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities, with a track record of managing multiple high-priority projects simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the capability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* Advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to address complex project issues and develop innovative solutions.

$101,500.00 - $139,600.00 annually

  

**Exeter Finance LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

#### **About Us**

Here at Baylor Scott & White Health we promote the well-being of all individuals, families, and communities. Baylor Scott and White is the largest not-for-profit healthcare system in Texas that empowers you to live well.

Our Core Values are:

* We serve faithfully by doing what's right with a joyful heart.
* We never settle by constantly striving for better.
* We are in it together by supporting one another and those we serve.
* We make an impact by taking initiative and delivering exceptional experience.

#### **Benefits**

Our benefits are designed to help you live well no matter where you are on your journey. For full details on coverage and eligibility, visit the Baylor Scott & White Benefits Hub to explore our offerings, which may include:

* Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
* 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
* Tuition Reimbursement
* PTO accrual beginning Day 1

*Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level.*

#### **Job Summary**

The Program Manager 1 manages many low to medium complexity programs. They ensure short and long-range strategic goals are met and aligned regionally or system-wide. This position supports a multi-center grant by leading implementation of the Reach for Care program, working alongside Dementia Care Navigators, monitoring program fidelity and compliance, and collaborating with investigators to ensure effective, person-centered support for caregivers of persons living with dementia.

#### **Essential Functions of the Role**

* Coordinates, manages and facilitates the design, planning and implementation of many programs and processes and/or quality improvement initiatives.
* Performs or helps collection and testing of data to identify opportunities for improvement. Identifies findings, outcomes and recommendations.
* Facilitates program help by soliciting input, maintaining records, and resolving issues. Monitors effectiveness and implements changes as necessary.
* Acts as point of contact to vendor partners to meet the needs of the program.
* Develops, maintains and seeks approval for program documentation such as training/educational materials, presentations, calendars, correspondence, etc.
* Ensures compliance with applicable policies, laws and regulatory agencies.

#### **Key Success Factors**

* Project/Program Management and/or quality improvement experience preferred
* Able to work in a fast paced, deadline motivated environment while stabilizing many demands
* Able to establish professional and cooperative relationships with multidisciplinary team members
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Good critical thinking skills with ability to solve problems and exercise sound judgement
* Good knowledge of applicable federal, state and regulatory requirements
* Able to successfully manage programs that meet strategic targets and/or contractual obligations
* Skill in the use of computers and related software
* Master's degree preferred
* PMP certification preferred

#### **Belonging Statement**

We believe that all people should feel welcomed, valued and supported.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* EDUCATION - Bachelor's
* EXPERIENCE - 2 Years of Experience

**Minimum Qualifications Summary**

  

**Certification & Education**

* Master’s degree or higher in Social Work, a social science-related discipline, or background in law, and at least five years of demonstrated child welfare experience

  

**Experience Required**

* Experience working with immigrant youth and families and underserved populations is strongly encouraged.

Develop and maintain regional and national case program(s) that provide child welfare-based recommendations on each UAC case, particularly in the areas of safe and timely release, identification of and development of corresponding recommendations for children with special needs, and placement recommendations.

Remote

Lukos has been delivering professional services to the Federal Government for 15 years. We help a variety of federal agencies in areas such as national security, homeland security, international development, training, analytics, healthcare, and other professional services. Since our founding, we have grown to support all military services and multiple federal civilian agencies.

About Our Name: Lukos is ancient Greek for “wolf”. The characteristics of the wolf match our approach to national security. The wolf is known for cunning, aggression, patience, and teamwork. "For the strength of the pack is the wolf, and the strength of the wolf is the pack."

At Lukos we take care of our pack by offering full time employees competitive benefits to include: medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off and Federal holidays.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

**Summary:**

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
* Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
* Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
* Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
* Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
* Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
* Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
* Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

**What Success Looks Like…**

**In 3 months…**

* Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
* Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

**In 6 months…**

* Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
* Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

**In 12 months…**

* Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
* Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
* Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

**What You Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
* Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
* Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
* A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
* Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
* Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
* PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.

jobs.title: TDA-certified administrator -DR Infrastructure Grant Project Manager / Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
**TDA-certified administrator is a MUST. You must provide a copy of your certification when responding to this job application.**

We are seeking an experienced **CDBG-DR Infrastructure Grant Project Manager / Compliance Specialist** to support the administration, coordination, and compliance oversight of multiple **CDBG-DR IRP projects**.

This role will provide project management, grant administration, compliance monitoring, reporting, and coordination support for federally funded infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have direct experience with **CDBG-DR**, **HUD-funded programs**, public infrastructure projects, environmental and procurement compliance, and multi-stakeholder coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day administration of assigned **CDBG-DR IRP infrastructure projects**
* Ensure compliance with **HUD**, **CDBG-DR**, state, and local requirements
* Coordinate with engineers, contractors, local government staff, grant administrators, and funding agencies
* Track project schedules, budgets, milestones, deliverables, and expenditures
* Prepare and maintain grant files, procurement records, contract documentation, and supporting compliance documentation
* Assist with environmental review coordination, labor standards documentation, Section 3, and other federal cross-cutting requirements
* Review pay applications, reimbursement requests, change orders, and supporting documentation for completeness and compliance
* Prepare progress reports, status updates, and other required reporting for funding agencies and project stakeholders
* Monitor project implementation to ensure adherence to approved scope, budget, and timeline
* Support audit readiness, monitoring visits, and responses to findings or information requests
* Identify risks, compliance issues, and project delays, and recommend corrective actions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in public administration, engineering, planning, construction management, finance, or related field, or equivalent relevant experience
* Minimum **3–5 years** of experience in **federally funded grant administration**, infrastructure project management, or compliance oversight
* Demonstrated experience with **CDBG**, **CDBG-DR**, **HUD**, **FEMA**, or similar federally funded recovery/infrastructure programs
* Experience supporting **water/wastewater** or other public infrastructure projects preferred
* Strong knowledge of federal procurement, contract administration, reimbursement processes, and recordkeeping requirements
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project tracking tools, and grant reporting systems

Pay: $50.00 - $60.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The role of Project Manager is to manage multiple projects and liaise between functional groups across the organization. As a member of the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), the Project Manager will manage projects to support executive of company strategy and expansion.

**Work Schedule:** Remote First

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* + Adheres to written EPMO process for managing projects
* + Conducts regular updates to project documentation to pass project audit process

jobs.title: Partner Program Manager
jobs.description:
**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

**About the job**

As we expand our partner ecosystem to support global growth targets, we are expanding our team to scale responsibly. We are seeking a versatile **Partner Program Manager** to drive an exceptional experience across our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. This balanced role bridges the gap between high-touch partner experience, strategic cross-functional project management, and advanced lifecycle automation. If you have a deep background in partnerships, an AI-forward mindset for process optimization, and hands-on experience with modern ecosystem toolsets, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our global network.

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* **Drive Program Modernization & Scale:** Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
* **Own Problem-Solving:** Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
* **Optimize the Partner Experience:** Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
* **Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics:** Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
* **Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities:** Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
* **Orchestrate High-Touch Communications:** Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution:** Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
* **The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset:** A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
* **Communication & Content:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

**Desired:**

* **Ecosystem Acumen:** Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.
* **Tech Stack & Automation Familiarity:** Hands-on exposure to CRM and partner ecosystem technologies (such as PRMs, account-mapping utilities, or data integration tools) with a strong desire to leverage software and AI to remove manual tasks.
* **Revenue Orientation:** Experience designing or supporting commercial program models, referral paths, or joint sales plays that directly drive channel pipelines.
* **Advanced Degree:** BA/BS degree or equivalent required. MBA is a plus.

**Location**

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Compensation**

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

* Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
* Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
* Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
* This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan.

**Sales & Business Operations Administrative Coordinator**

**Work Location:** Remote  
**Position Type:**Temporary – 4-month assignment with the possibility of extension based on business needs and operational requirements.  
**Work Schedule:** Candidates must be available to work Pacific Time business hours, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM PT.

**Position Summary**

Talent Table is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Sales & Business Operations Administrative Coordinator to support daily sales operations, administrative workflows, and internal coordination.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting private-sector sales or business operations teams and demonstrate strong organizational skills, independent follow-through, and the ability to turn management direction, meeting notes, and communications into actionable tasks.

This position is responsible for maintaining organized tracking systems, coordinating deadlines and deliverables, managing business documentation, and ensuring assigned activities continue moving forward without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor the status of quotes, purchase orders, and pending documentation, ensuring appropriate follow-up with assigned personnel.
* Prepare concise status reports highlighting upcoming deadlines, priorities, and outstanding actions.

**3. Document & Agreement Management**

* Organize and maintain electronic folders, agreements, contracts, and supporting sales documentation.
* Establish consistent file-naming conventions, document organization, and version control.
* Maintain accurate records of document locations, agreement statuses, and related correspondence.
* Coordinate document requests, approvals, signatures, and distribution to appropriate internal departments.

**4. Internal Coordination & Operational Handoffs**

* Support the transition of administrative responsibilities by organizing handoff documents, training materials, and existing process instructions.
* Document administrative workflows and maintain reference materials to support operational continuity.
* Coordinate with sales, account management, accounting, and other internal teams to facilitate timely completion of assigned activities.
* Track internal handoffs and confirm that required information has been received by the appropriate team members.

**5. Sales Materials & General Administrative Support**

* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, anticipate next steps, and consistently follow through on assignments.
* Ability to interpret meeting notes and general instructions and translate them into structured action plans.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience coordinating calendars, managing business documentation, and maintaining tracking spreadsheets.
* Ability to handle confidential business information professionally.
* Familiarity with public-sector contracts, procurement processes, or government clients is a plus but not required.

**Key Performance Expectations**

* Assigned action items are accurately documented, prioritized, and consistently followed through to completion.
* Sales records, agreements, and supporting documentation remain organized, accessible, and current.
* Upcoming deadlines, renewals, and pending activities are communicated proactively.
* Management receives clear visibility into progress, outstanding items, and required decisions.
* Administrative handoffs are coordinated effectively to support continuity across departments.
* Assigned responsibilities are managed independently with minimal supervision.

This position provides administrative and operational coordination rather than direct sales, account management, proposal development, or financial decision-making.
