jobs.description:
The Power Sensing and Regulation Product Line Quality Leader develops and deploys the global quality strategy for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line. The role covers quality planning, quality assurance, quality control and the Quality Management System across the full product lifecycle, from tendering and product development to sourcing, manufacturing, project execution and service.
  
The role is reporting to the Product Line Leader, and functionally to the Business Line Quality Leader. The Product Line Quality Leader functionally leads factory quality leaders and collaborates with engineering, operations, sourcing, project and business leaders. The role is accountable for a strong quality culture, high customer satisfaction, prevention of customer escapes and continuous improvement of product and process quality.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy the global quality strategy, priorities and governance for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line, in full alignment with Power Transmission’s Quality roadmap.

* Drive the Zero-Defect Framework towards Level 4 through clear action plans, standard work, capability building and regular progress reviews.

* Ensure holistic integration of the factories' Quality Management Systems into Power Transmission's Business Management System. Take an active role in shaping the QMS to support the evolution of the business, in partnership with Power Transmission's central functions.

* Functionally lead and coach the factory quality teams. Set common standards, operating rhythms, measures and expectations across sites, and be accountable for meeting the Product Line Quality KPI targets.

* Be accountable for fulfilling quality engineering requirements during New Product Introduction (NPI) in the Product Line. Cover the full process from Design FMEA and Process FMEA through Control Plans and Reaction Plans, and drive aligned quality-built-in roadmaps across the Product Line.

* Lead complex global customer complaints and root cause analyses. Ensure rapid containment, clear customer communication, verified root cause and sustainable corrective action.

* Apply lessons learned and read across with factories and functions. Ensure relevant learning is built into risk analyses, standards and process controls.

* Drive a strong problem-solving culture using structured methods such as 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis.

* Use digital tools, data analytics and AI to improve prevention, traceability, risk detection and decision-making.

* Manage and drive the Customer Experience (CX) roadmap for the Product Line. Translate customer feedback and quality performance into clear priorities and improvement actions.

* Monitor and improve customer escapes, cost of poor quality, complaint closure, audit findings and first-pass yield.

* Build strong cross-functional teams with technical experts and business leaders to solve quality issues and deliver improvement plans.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* University degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

* At least 10 years of experience in quality, engineering or manufacturing, including leadership of global or multi-site activities.

* Strong technical knowledge of power sensing and regulation products, including design, manufacturing, testing, installation and service risks. Experience with instrument transformers, sensors, voltage regulation equipment, monitoring systems or related control technologies is preferred.

* Strong knowledge of Design FMEA, Process FMEA, APQP, Control Plans, Reaction Plans, MSA, SPC, process capability and ISO 9001.

* Experience with IEC or IEEE standards is a strong advantage.

* Proven experience leading major customer complaints, structured root cause analysis and corrective action programmes.

* Experience with digital quality systems, data analytics, automation or AI applications is an advantage.

* Fluent English.

**Desired Skills and Characteristics**

* Strong functional leadership and the ability to influence across a global matrix organisation.

* Customer-focused, fact-based and decisive during complex quality issues.

* Able to build trust and align technical experts, factory teams and business leaders around common goals.

* Clear communicator with the confidence to engage customers and senior leaders.

* Proactive, disciplined and focused on prevention, learning and sustainable results.

* Comfortable working with multicultural and cross-functional teams.

* Curious about digitalisation and AI, with a practical focus on business and quality outcomes.

* Collaborates openly with peers and functions, shares knowledge and works towards the best outcome for the Product Line and Power Transmission.

* Provides practical support, coaching and clear direction to factories and teams so they can meet their commitments and be successful.

* Demonstrates the GE Vernova Values in decisions, collaboration, customer engagement and daily leadership.

**Additional Information**
==========================

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

This role builds and sustains customer relationships and achieves the client’s recognition of Cotiviti as a partner. The CSM’s goals are to ensure that existing clients recognize the value of Cotiviti’s solutions and to sustain/grow the client relationship.

This position is focused on our **Clinical Chart Validation (CCV) line of business.**

Responsibilities:

* Manages the operational execution of the auditing program by working with the client operational managers, provider services managers, network managers, claims managers, member services managers, and IT managers.
* Works closely with the Senior Client Services Manager and Director, Client Services to serve as a primary account manager for all levels of client contacts for large and/or multiple accounts. Identifies important trends by monitoring and investigating processing and financial / savings data, communicates to others both internally and externally through formal processes, and executes action plans where necessary.
* Develops, contributes, and/or manages projects, process improvements, and strategic initiatives consisting of cross functional and cross company teams that include: Provider/payer communication efforts, all Cotiviti and client systems, all miscellaneous ad hoc requests from the client.

* Assists with the design and communication of all client-facing reporting that is specific for each client.

jobs.title: Care Team Lead, Care Experience
jobs.description:
**About Empathy**

Empathy is on a mission to help families through life’s most challenging moments. Our award-winning product, powered by tech and driven by purpose, provides peace of mind by guiding families through all the tedious and time-consuming tasks associated with loss. With a combination of tech and human support, we enable families to focus on what truly matters and support them through the emotions that follow.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, and dedicated to providing world-class solutions to families in need. We work collaboratively to identify pain points and design elegant solutions that empower and support our users.

**About the Role:**

As a Care Team Lead, your deep understanding of Empathy’s products, services, and processes is essential to confidently guide both users and the Care Team. You are accountable for the **quality, consistency, and impact** of care delivered by your team, ensuring that Care Managers and Care Specialists show up with empathy, clarity, and excellence - and that our users feel supported, understood, and confident at every touchpoint.

This role is centered on **people leadership, performance, and outcomes.** You will set clear expectations, assess quality through regular review, and provide hands-on coaching that supports growth while maintaining a high bar for care delivery. You play a critical role in shaping team culture by modeling Empathy’s values and translating strategy into day-to-day behaviors that improve both user experience and team effectiveness.

While cross-functional collaboration and process improvement are an important function of this role, the core of the role is leading a high performance team: developing talent, strengthening culture, and ensuring our care consistently meets the needs of the families we serve.

This role will continue to evolve as Empathy grows and is well suited for someone who is energized by ownership, accountability, and building strong, engaged teams.

  
Requirements:  
  

**About You:**

* 2+ years of experience leading teams in a customer-facing or care-focused environment (counseling/support/concierge services, or related fields)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time management skills
* Comfortable using data and qualitative insights to assess performance and guide decision-making
* Able to work autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced, complex, and matrixed remote environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to manage multiple priorities
* Deep care for team culture and user experience, with a proactive and growth-oriented mindset
* Adaptable and ready to take on evolving responsibilities as the team scales and needs shift.

**More Information:**

* *The salary for this position ranges between $68,000-$75,000 annually.*

Empathy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees.

  
In this role you will:  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership**

* Lead and manage a team of Care Managers and/or Care Specialists, ensuring they provide exceptional support to our users.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, and offer professional development opportunities.
* Own team-level outcomes related to care quality, user experience, and consistency across calls and chats.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative team culture rooted in empathy, equity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Provide real-time support to team members navigating challenging calls, scheduling conflicts, or urgent needs.

**Quality and Outcomes**

* Monitor call and chat quality through regular QA reviews and performance analysis, delivering timely and actionable feedback.
* Identify patterns and trends in quality or performance and proactively address gaps through coaching and partnership with Training and Development.
* Serve as an escalation point to model best practices for care in complex or high-impact user situations.

**Operations**

* Own the effective execution of existing workflows and team processes, ensuring clarity, consistency, and quality.
* Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, utilization, and user outcomes.
* Partner with Care Operations and Training and Development to surface frontline insights that inform process improvements and enablement efforts.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams as the Care Team representative bringing frontline context and advocating for care quality and team needs.
* Contribute insights that help ensure product, operational, and process decisions support strong user and team outcomes.

**Training and Development**

* Partner withTraining & Development to identify learning needs informed by quality and performance signals.
* Reinforce training through coaching and feedback that translates learnings into practice.
* Support onboarding by helping new team members understand care standards, expectations, and team norms.
* Assist with the hiring process by participating in interviews, evaluations, or onboarding planning as needed to help build and sustain a high performing team.

**Care Team SME**

* Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, services, and processes.
* Handle a limited number of User cases as needed (predominantly VIPs, high-value LI users, etc).
* Oversee the resolution of complex user inquiries or issues, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Treering**

At Treering, we help people capture and preserve life’s most meaningful moments, from school milestones to unforgettable travel experiences. Our innovative memory-as-a-service platform combines intuitive, AI-enabled tools with a seamless user experience to make creating personalized keepsakes easy and joyful. We’re a fast-growing, purpose-driven company expanding beyond yearbooks into travel and experiential memories, and we’re equally intentional about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and connected to the impact of their work.

  

**Job Description:**  
  
As a Customer Success Manager at Treering, you will manage day-to-day customer interactions and help customers achieve their goals with our products and services. You will work directly with customers to build strong relationships, resolve issues, and provide support, while collaborating with internal teams to ensure smooth solution delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, acting as their main point of contact during the contract period.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by understanding their needs and proactively addressing any concerns or challenges.
* Assist customers in onboarding, product training, and ongoing support to maximize their use of Treering's products and services.
* Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., sales, product, and support) to resolve customer issues and provide tailored solutions.
* Monitor customer health metrics, track feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement or additional services.
* Communicate effectively with customers about product updates, new features, and best practices.
* Proactively manage customer retention and renewal processes, ensuring a smooth transition at the end of the temporary period.
* Document and report on customer feedback, challenges, and successes to the leadership team.
* Proficiency with CRM software and customer support tools.

### **Requirements:**

* 2-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related field.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts and prioritize tasks efficiently.
* Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to addressing customer needs.
* Experience working with software, SaaS, or tech-related companies is a plus.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Flexibility and adaptability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Proficiency with CRM software and customer support tools.

### **Why Join Us?**

* Gain valuable experience working with a dynamic team in a fast-growing company.
* Flexible remote work environment.
* Opportunity to make a significant impact on customer satisfaction and retention.

If you’re passionate about creating meaningful customer relationships and thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in shaping memorable experiences for our customers and contributing to Treering’s continued growth. Apply today and help us deliver exceptional service to the communities we support.

jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:**  
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care. Through our AI-native platform, MosaicOS™, we unite fragmented technologies into a single, intelligent ecosystem designed to help clinical teams work faster, think smarter and deliver better care.
  
  
Built cloud-native and designed for continuous iteration, MosaicOS™ is engineered to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges. Our platform expands clinical capacity, improves diagnostic quality by combining human expertise with AI, and turns operational complexity into strategic advantage through seamless integration or replacement of legacy imaging systems.
  
  
Every AI tool within MosaicOS™ is validated across tens of millions of exams to ensure safe, reliable and meaningful clinical impact. With a ransomware-resistant design and built-in redundancy, our platform is designed to ensure continuity of care and protect both patients and operations.
  
  
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is building technology that evolves with clinicians to advance clinical excellence and improve patient outcomes. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of medical imaging, join us!
  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  

* Advanced Incident Response: Lead complex, high-severity, multi-system investigations; assess incident scope and risk; and drive effective resolution using independent technical judgment and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Major Incident & Escalation Leadership: Provide technical direction during critical incidents, guide investigation strategies, determine escalation needs, and communicate clear next steps to incident command and leadership.
* Clinical Operations & Stakeholder Communication: Apply radiology and clinical operations knowledge to assess patient care impact, manage stakeholder concerns, and translate technical issues for clinical, operational, and executive audiences.
* Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Develop incident reports, root cause analyses, advanced troubleshooting guides, and runbooks while identifying recurring issues and driving improvements with engineering and product teams.
* Team Mentorship & Operational Readiness: Mentor and coach Clinical IT Operations Analysts, support onboarding and training, and reinforce consistent troubleshooting, escalation, shift discipline, and communication standards.
* Additional Requirements & Scheduling Flexibility: Ability to work evenings and overnight as needed, participate in on-call rotations, travel up to 15%, apply subject-matter expertise to emerging operational challenges, and perform other duties as assigned. Work schedules and assigned shifts may be modified based on business needs.

**DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**  

* Technical Support & Incident Management: Significant experience in IT operations, technical support, or incident response within healthcare IT, clinical technology, or complex SaaS environments.
* Advanced Troubleshooting & Problem-Solving: Proven ability to independently resolve high-severity incidents, troubleshoot distributed systems, integrations, and APIs, and make decisive judgments under pressure.
* Clinical Technology Expertise: Strong understanding of radiology and clinical workflows, with PACS, RIS, or other clinical IT platform experience strongly preferred.
* Communication & ITIL Knowledge: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, ability to communicate technical issues to executive, clinical, and operational stakeholders, and strong knowledge of ITIL Incident, Major Incident, and Problem Management frameworks.
* AI-Enabled Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted tools and recommendations, exercise independent judgment beyond established playbooks, mentor peers, and improve team practices and operational standards without formal authority.

**WHY MOSAIC CLINICAL TECHNOLOGIES:**  

* Competitive Benefits package - Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
* Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
* Flexible Remote Schedules
* Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
* Proudly Certified as a Great Place to Work for Five Consecutive Years

**FOR MORE INFORMATION:**

The salary range for this position is $86,900.00-$130,200.00. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

  

1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

**About The Role**
------------------

Headway is building a new Care Navigation & Triage program to help patients leaving emergency departments, inpatient psychiatric units and partial hospitalization programs get connected to the right mental health care, quickly and safely. The weeks after discharge are among the highest-risk periods in a patient's care, and connecting patients to follow-up care during that window can make a real difference. As a Care Navigator, you'll coordinate each patient's path from hospital referral to a confirmed first appointment. You'll be the main point of contact for hospital partners and patients, working with a licensed Clinical Assessor, and you'll help shape a program that's still being built.

This is a part-time, remote contract role.

**You will be great for this role if:**
---------------------------------------

* You have at least 2 years of experience in behavioral health care coordination, case management, patient navigation or hospital discharge planning.
* You are comfortable working with patients who have recently been discharged and may be in distress, and you know when to bring in clinical support.
* You are highly organized and can manage a high volume of referrals and follow-ups with tight turnaround, without dropping details.
* You are a clear, warm communicator with patients, hospital staff and providers.
* You are persistent and resourceful at solving practical barriers to care, such as insurance, transportation and access to community resources.
* You are energized by building something new, and comfortable with workflows that will change as the program grows.
* Familiarity with insurance and community resources in Missouri or Virginia is a plus.

**Role responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Receive referrals from partner hospitals and act as the main contact for their discharge planners and care teams.
* Route each referral using set guidelines and a triage protocol, either straight to a Headway provider or to a Clinical Assessor for evaluation.
* Schedule patients with the Clinical Assessor, then book them into the level of care the assessor recommends: a Headway provider, a specialty program or a community resource.
* Follow up to confirm patients attended care, and step in quickly if an appointment falls through.
* Connect patients to practical support (transportation, food, insurance and benefits questions) and coordinate between their providers.
* Build and maintain a list of local referral resources in each market.
* Follow escalation protocols and bring in clinical staff right away when a patient may be in crisis. Level-of-care decisions are made only by licensed clinicians.
* Document interactions with patients and complete all work within Headway's designated systems, following HIPAA and Headway's privacy and confidentiality requirements. Patient information is never stored or kept outside those systems.

**Compensation**
----------------

We have 1-2 openings for a Care Navigator. The role requires a minimum commitment of 20 hours per week. The Care Navigator will be paid an hourly rate of $43.50 and must set up or have an existing LLC or S-Corp.

Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD) is a community-based non-profit organization established in Richmond, Contra Costa County, California, in 1980. Since then, LFCD has expanded its operations to Alameda and Sacramento counties with its headquarters located in Oakland, California.

LFCD delivers programs and services from seven locations in more than 35 languages. The organization provides community development, affordable real estate, workforce development, education, and human services that primarily support low-income individuals and families, refugees, immigrants, transitional-age youth, seniors, individuals with disabilities, and other underserved populations.

new_jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
  
**The required shift for this position is:**  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
The Resilient Recovery Program provides youth and adults with substance use and co-occurring mental health services in the form of individual and group counseling and care coordination. This program is committed to working with underserved communities from a variety of backgrounds. We strive to meet the ongoing needs of individuals struggling with mental health issues, substance use disorders, and co-occurring mental health issues.
  
  
Care Coordinators are an important part of the San Mateo County Outpatient Program. Utilizing a trauma informed approach, they are responsible for assessing adult and youth client needs and strengths to collaboratively create treatment plans/problem lists with their clients that support their health and recovery. The care coordinator/counselor will provide individual and group counseling to adults and youth; deliver evidence-based curricula in accordance with program specific requirements. Care Coordinators assists clients in navigating systems of care while providing a supportive treatment environment.
  
  
May work weekends and holidays as needed.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Individual Treatment Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates intakes/orientations, comprehensive assessments, individualized treatment planning, crisis, collateral, case management and individual counseling sessions with clients.
* Offers clinical support and counseling to assist clients in meeting their treatment goals including providing feedback, setting boundaries, and celebrating successes.
* Proactively links clients to both internal and external resources based on their treatment needs and follows up on the progress/status.

**Treatment Setting Responsibilities:**  

* Facilitates group counseling sessions and teaches classes on various treatment-related topics.
* Conducts screenings and intake assessments to determine client’s eligibility and ASAM level of care placement.
* Performs crisis intervention and communicates with treatment team as unforeseen situations arise.
* Completes and attends required training and meetings.
* Coordinate discharge planning in collaboration with the rest of the treatment team.
* Comply with certifying agency requirements for registration/certification renewal.
* Plans and facilitates client celebrations and special events.
* Will work one weekend day based on rotating schedule to facilitate the scheduled weekend groups.
* Will work at agency’s main office and in addition to co-location sites which may include schools, community health centers, in-home, and partner agencies.

**Documentation Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborates with each caseload client and other available internal and external resources to develop/maintain treatment plans/problem lists, transition/discharge plans, progress notes and appropriate updates in support of the health and recovery needs of the client.
* Properly documents all individual and group counseling sessions, intake and assessments, completes discharge paperwork and referrals in a timely manner as required by DMC and county.
* Maintains accurate records by entering documentation into various electronic systems for all caseload clients in accordance with guidelines established by HealthRIGHT 360 to satisfy internal and external evaluating requirements.
* Will participate in Peer Chart/ Utilization Reviews for preparation of program audits. Will adhere to documentation policies and procedures set forth by Compliance Department.
* Be responsive and proactive in all correspondences with referring parties such as behavioral health providers, probation, social workers, and the Quality Improvement Dept. via treatment status reports, phone calls, faxes, etc.
* Responds to records updates and corrections in a timely manner to ensure documentation compliance and accuracy.
* Will assist in providing written progress reports/narratives to Clinical Program Manager or Directors as requested.

**Productivity and Coverage Responsibilities:**

* Ensure coverage during absences or unplanned events by coordinating with team members and management.
* Adjusts workload as necessary to ensure uninterrupted service delivery, including stepping in to provide support during peak demand times or staff shortages.
* Adheres to the program’s scheduling protocols to maintain appropriate client-to-provider ratios.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Education, Certification, and Experience
  

* High School diploma or equivalent OR associate degree in a related field/
* Must be registered as an Alcohol and Other Drug Counselor or as an SUD Counselor with CA approved certifying agency (CCAPP, CADTP, or CAADE).

new_jobs.title: Sales Strategy & Operations Manager — Corporate & Public Sector
new_jobs.description:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the Role**

Smarsh is looking for a Manager of Sales Strategy & Operations to be the operating backbone for our Corporate and Public Sector sales segments. You'll own Sales Ops for both segments end to end — strategy, planning, and execution — and act as the primary Ops partner to the VP of Sales, turning data into the narrative and recommendations that drive their business.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you're as comfortable designing a territory model or building a forecast as you are presenting a recommendation to segment leadership. You’ll work closely with a Customer Success Operations counterpart supporting these same segments and help connect the pre- and post-sale operating model. This is an individual contributor role today, with potential to build and lead a team as the segments scale.

### **How will you contribute?**

**Sales strategy & planning**

* Own annual and in-year planning for Corporate and Public Sector: territory design, account segmentation, quota setting, and capacity planning.
* Translate segment strategy into operating plans, priorities, and resourcing decisions in partnership with the VP of Sales and their leadership team.
* Identify risks and opportunities in the business before they show up in bookings, and bring recommendations, not just observations.

**Forecasting, pipeline & revenue cadence**

* Run the forecasting and pipeline management process for both segments: cadence, hygiene, deal inspection, and accuracy.
* Build and maintain the operating rhythm — pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, QBRs — that keeps segment leadership aligned and accountable.
* Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Commissions on deal structuring, quota attainment, and incentive execution for your segments.

**Reporting, analytics & business reviews**

* Build the reporting and dashboards that give a trusted, real-time view of pipeline, forecast, and performance.
* Go beyond status reporting — use cohort, funnel, and productivity analysis to explain what's driving performance and what to do about it.
* Own the analytics behind monthly and quarterly business reviews for Corporate and Public Sector.

**Cross-functional & systems partnership**

* Partner with Enterprise Applications to translate Sales Ops needs into systems requirements, and help prioritize the roadmap for tools these segments depend on (Salesforce, forecasting, sales engagement/intelligence platforms).
* Align closely with the CS Ops partner on these segments to connect new business, renewal, and expansion data and processes.
* Build strong working relationships with Finance, Marketing, and Enterprise Applications, and influence outcomes without formal authority over those teams.

**AI & process innovation**

* Bring an AI-first mindset: identify where AI and automation can improve forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and day-to-day seller productivity for these segments.
* Pilot new tools and approaches proactively rather than waiting to be asked, and scale what works.

### **What will you bring?**

* 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related GTM function, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience with territory design, quota setting, and annual sales planning processes.
* Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce, including reporting and dashboard build.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable building models and pipeline/forecast analysis from scratch, not just reviewing someone else's output.
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and presenting recommendations clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Background in management consulting or investment banking, particularly with an MBA. (Preferred)
* Experience supporting Public Sector or regulated-industry sales motions.(Preferred)
* Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in a Sales Ops context, with a point of view on where AI can change how a sales org operates.(Preferred)
* SQL skills and experience building in PowerBI. (Preferred)

The above salary range represents Smarsh's good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible base compensation at the time of posting.

Any applicable bonus programs will be discussed during the recruiting process.

The salary for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, location, specialty and training. Local cost of living assessments are done for each new hire at the time of offer.

**About our culture**

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

new_jobs.title: Staff Revenue Operations Manager, Revenue Planning & Analytics
new_jobs.description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We are looking for a Staff Revenue Operations Manager to help shape how EvenUp plans for and achieves its growth targets. As we scale our go-to-market organization, this person will own the bottoms-up revenue model that connects company-level goals to the underlying assumptions across our Sales and broader GTM teams.

You'll partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to build annual and quarterly plans, evaluate revenue performance, and conduct the strategic analyses that inform decisions around sales capacity, quotas, territories, and resource allocation. This is a highly analytical role that requires both strong modeling skills and the ability to translate complex business questions into clear recommendations.

**Title and compensation to be determined based on candidate experience.**

**What you'll do:**

* **Own revenue planning and forecasting:** Build and maintain EvenUp's bottoms-up GTM model, connecting revenue targets to the underlying drivers of performance, including pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, sales capacity, ramp time, churn, and expansion. Translate company-level growth targets into detailed operating assumptions and forecasts.
* **Lead annual and quarterly planning:** Partner with Revenue Operations and GTM leadership to develop annual and quarterly plans across relevant departments. Evaluate what needs to be true across headcount, productivity, conversion, and retention to achieve our goals, identifying key assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
* **Drive strategic GTM analysis:** Lead analyses that inform how we structure and allocate our GTM resources, including territory design, customer segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, and sales productivity. Develop recommendations that help leadership make informed tradeoffs as the business scales.
* **Evaluate business performance:** Analyze actual performance against plan, identify the underlying drivers of variances, and assess their implications for future results. Build scenarios and sensitivities to help leadership understand potential outcomes and determine where adjustments are needed.
* **Partner with GTM leadership:** Serve as a strategic thought partner to Revenue Operations and functional leaders, translating complex analyses into clear insights and recommendations. Help leaders pressure-test assumptions, evaluate investment decisions, and prioritize opportunities to improve revenue performance.
* **Strengthen planning methodologies:** Improve the models, assumptions, and analytical approaches used to plan and forecast the business. Partner with Finance, Data, and other cross-functional teams as needed to ensure planning is grounded in reliable data and reflects how EvenUp's GTM organization operates.

**What we look for:**

* **Relevant experience:** 10+ years of experience in Revenue Planning & Analytics, GTM Strategy & Planning, Strategic Finance, Sales Finance, Revenue Operations, or a related function, ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company.
* **Revenue modeling expertise:** You have built and owned a bottoms-up revenue forecast, sales capacity model, or comparable operating model. You understand how assumptions around pipeline, win rates, deal size, quota attainment, ramp time, churn, and expansion translate into business outcomes.
* **Strong analytical and quantitative skills:** You can build models from scratch, evaluate scenarios, pressure-test assumptions, and break down complex business questions into structured analyses. You are comfortable working with large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* **GTM and SaaS business acumen:** You understand the drivers of revenue growth in a recurring-revenue business and how decisions around sales capacity, territory design, segmentation, quotas, and productivity affect performance.
* **Strategic problem-solving:** You can identify the right questions to investigate, determine what the data needs to show, and develop recommendations that help leaders make decisions about planning, resource allocation, and GTM strategy.
* **Cross-functional partnership:** You communicate analytical findings clearly and can work directly with senior stakeholders to challenge assumptions, align on plans, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
* **Ownership and execution:** You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment, managing ambiguous problems independently, and building planning models and processes that can evolve as the business scales.

**Benefits & Perks:**

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:

* Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
* Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
* Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
* 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
* A home office stipend.
* 401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
* Paid parental leave.
* A local in-person meet-up program.
* Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.

*(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)*

The Presidio Trust is seeking an Public Safety Program Manager to join its Department of Public Safety. The Presidio Trust is a unique federal agency that stewards and shares the Presidio, one of the most visited national park sites in America and a place where people live and businesses thrive. The Trust manages the Presidio through a triple bottom line focus: being visited and loved by all, being a model of environmental stewardship, and demonstrating excellence in all our operations.

Reporting to the Chief Park Officer, the Public Safety Program Manager is responsible for the overall development and management of the Trust’s comprehensive public safety program. They will direct, manage, oversee, and supervise work performed by Trust staff in the areas of fire prevention and emergency management. The Manager will manage the effectiveness of the department’s fire and life safety code plan review and inspection program, the Agency’s emergency management program, capabilities, and continuity of operations planning, and the Agency’s drone program. They are responsible for managing service contracts with the United State Park Police and the San Francisco Fire Department for law enforcement, fire and emergency medical services.

*This is a full-time position with benefits and a starting pay range of $172,458 to $188,706 based in the San Francisco Bay Area. The starting base salary is dependent on the experience and qualifications of the candidate. Applications received by November 12, 2026, will receive first consideration.*

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage Trust’s comprehensive public safety program
* Manage the contracts with the United States Park Police (USPP) for law enforcement activities and services and special events support. Perform coordinated annual planning, hold regular meetings, review reports, review and approve invoices. Evaluate level of service and performance, including by developing and reviewing metrics. Coordinate with Trust and USPP leadership to assure compliance with contract terms. Lead and manage contract and budget negotiations with USPP in collaboration with the Chief Park Officer, Trust Legal and Finance.
* Manage the contract with the San Francisco Fire Department (SFFD) for fire and emergency medical services. Hold regular meetings, review reports, review and approve invoices. Evaluate level of service and performance, including by developing and reviewing metrics. Coordinate with Trust and SFFD leadership to assure compliance with contract terms. Lead and manage contract and budget negotiations with SFFD in collaboration with the Chief Park Officer, Trust Legal and Finance.
* Serve as initial point of contact for questions or concerns from the United States Park Police, the San Francisco Fire Department and the San Franscico Department of Emergency Management and refer questions and concerns to the appropriate Presidio Trust management official.
* Provide leadership and oversight of the Trust's Emergency Management and Continuity of Operations Program, including emergency planning, preparedness, response, recovery, mitigation, and continuity of essential operations. Develop and maintain the requirements of the Emergency Management Accreditation Program (EMAP).
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with federal, state, regional, and local public safety and emergency management partners. Coordinate interagency planning, operational readiness, mutual aid, resource requests, and information sharing for emergencies, special events, and other incidents affecting the Presidio. Maintain the Trust’s Mutual Aid Agreement with the San Francisco Department of Emergency Management.
* Provide emergency management and public safety leadership during significant incidents, including outside normal business hours when required. Coordinate with the Trust's Duty Officer, responding agencies, and executive leadership in accordance with established notification, escalation, and emergency response procedures.
* In collaboration with the Trust’s Emergency Management Specialist, oversee the Trust’s Department Operations Center during emergency activations in accordance with the Trust’s Emergency Management and Continuity of Operations Plan and established Incident Command System roles and authorities. Serve as or designate the Trust's official representative to the San Francisco Department of Emergency Management and other agency emergency operations centers or command posts, as appropriate.
* Provide administrative and programmatic oversight of the Trust’s Fire Marshal’s Office, including fire prevention, fire and life safety inspections, plan review, code enforcement, and public education. Ensure the program is appropriately staffed, resourced, and coordinated with other Trust departments. Supervise Fire Marshal, who serves as the Trust’s Authority Having Jurisdiction.
* Provide management oversight of the Trust's Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) program, including regulatory compliance, Federal Aviation Administration authorizations and waivers, pilot qualifications and training, operational policies, equipment and technology, flight safety, and commercial UAS permitting. Oversee the integration of UAS capabilities into emergency response, public safety operations, incident assessment, and other authorized Trust activities.
* Lead development and periodic review of public safety policies, procedures, and operational standards
* Responsible for developing and managing the execution of the department’s annual operating plan, including operating budget, projects, and key performance indicators.
* Write detailed reports and other documents.
* Establish, research and maintain appropriate files.
* Other duties as assigned.

new_jobs.title: Scheduling & Intake Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Scheduling & Intake Coordinator – Home Health (South Bay)**

South Bay, CA | Full-Time | **$25–$32/hour + Full Benefits**

**Healthcare operations designed around people, systems, and impact.**

At Health Link Home Health & Hospice, we believe great patient care starts with strong operations. For over 20 years, we've served the Bay Area with a focus on quality, responsiveness, and coordinated care. Our scheduling and intake teams are a critical part of that mission — they are the engine that keeps patient care moving.

We are seeking a **Scheduling & Intake Coordinator** to support our **South Bay operations**. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, proactive, calm under pressure, and motivated by meaningful, patient-centered work.

### **What Makes This Role Different**

* Direct impact on patient care and clinician success

* Fast-paced, collaborative healthcare environment

* Structured systems with real-time leadership support

* Strong partnership with clinical, intake, and operations teams

* An established, stable agency with long-term growth

* A culture that values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* **$25–$32/hour** (depending on experience)

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance

* 401(k) with employer matching

* Paid Time Off

* Opportunities for growth within a multi-branch organization

* Supportive leadership and team-based environment

### **Your Role**

* Coordinate and manage daily clinician schedules based on patient needs, clinical priorities, and staff availability

* Support intake processes including referral coordination, data entry, and case placement

* Partner closely with clinical leadership, business development, and operations teams

* Respond quickly and effectively to urgent scheduling changes, call-outs, and patient needs

* Communicate clearly with clinicians, patients, referral sources, and leadership

* Assist with timely initiation of care and visit coverage

* Proactively identify and resolve scheduling or intake barriers

* Support field staff to ensure patient care is never delayed

### **What Will Help You Succeed**

* At least one year of scheduling or intake experience in home health, hospice, or healthcare operations (preferred)

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Ability to manage high call volume and competing priorities

* Comfort working in fast-moving, real-time operations

* Solid computer skills and ability to learn healthcare systems quickly

* Clear, professional communication skills

* Detail-oriented, reliable, and solution-focused mindset

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent healthcare operations experience preferred

* Minimum one year in healthcare scheduling, intake, or coordination role preferred

* Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare compliance is a plus

* Strong customer-service orientation toward patients and clinicians

### **Work Environment**

* Location: South Bay office (in person)

* Schedule: Monday–Friday; weekends as operationally needed

* Team-based office supporting active home health operations

### **Who This Role Is For**

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being at the center of operations, solving problems in real time, supporting clinicians, and playing a direct role in patient care delivery.

If you are proactive, organized, and motivated by meaningful healthcare work, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.

**Location:** 4010 Moorpark Ave Ste 112 San Jose, Ca 95117
  
**Schedule:** Tuesday - Saturday or Sunday - Thursday
  
About the Opportunity
  
The Patient Care Coordinator position supports all department functions in reception and intake of new referrals, as well as maintaining all clinical field staff schedules for admissions, discharges, resumption of cares, recertification visits, and routine follow up visits as needed. The Patient Care Coordinator position will also assist in answering the phone.
  
Responsibilities
  

* Completes department functions, duties, and activities for Intake of new referrals and maintain all clinical field staff schedules.
* Assists in the smooth processing of referrals, and acts as a liaison between LORIAN and referral sources.

**Required Qualifications:**  

* Working knowledge of Medical terminology.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Systems (i.e. Word, Excel, etc.) and with an EMR system, HCHB is preferred.
* Must have professional and customer-service-driven phone and communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively and tactfully with patients, doctors, and all customers of Lorian Health (LORIAN) in a productive, constructive, and professional manner.
* Strong ability to organize and prioritize workload on a regular basis based on the quantity of incoming referrals.
* Ability to be flexible and to follow verbal and written instruction in a fast-paced team-oriented environment.
* Proficient in completing routine paperwork, multi-tasking, and providing appropriate follow-up as needed.
* Outstanding interpersonal relationship building.
* Maintains confidential patient information in accordance with privacy and security standards of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and other applicable state.

Why Join us?
  
We are committed to our employees' well-being, offering a comprehensive employee benefits package that includes, but is not limited to:
  

* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability, EAP, 401(K) with 4% match
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Mileage reimbursement or company vehicle (role dependent), plus fuel card
* Employee referral program and opportunities for growth and advancement

**Pay:** $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

new_jobs.title: Inventory & Client Services Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Borg Trucking, Inc. is a family-owned business specializing in white-glove receiving, storage, delivery, and installation services for interior designers, furniture showrooms, and residential design projects throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

We work with designers and their vendors to coordinate the logistics behind furnishing homes and other spaces, from receiving and inspecting individual pieces to storing, tracking, and delivering entire projects.

We're a small, hardworking team operating out of multiple warehouse facilities in South San Francisco. Our work is detail-driven, fast-paced, and constantly changing. We take pride in providing reliable, personalized service and maintaining strong relationships with our clients.

**About the Position**

We're seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Inventory & Client Services Coordinator** to help manage daily inventory operations and client communication.

This position serves as an important connection between our office, warehouse and clients. You'll be responsible for ensuring merchandise is accurately documented, inventory records are current and client requests are handled promptly,

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through on details, communicates effectively, and can manage competing priorities without constant supervision.

This is primarily an office-based position, but it requires regular interaction with our warehouse team and occasional hands-on involvement in warehouse operations.

**Inventory Management & Receiving**

* Process and accurately enter incoming furniture, lighting, rugs, artwork, accessories, and other merchandise into our inventory management system.
* Review packing slips, purchase orders, bills of lading, and receiving documentation to verify shipment details.
* Match merchandise to the correct client, project, vendor, and item description.
* Review inspection photographs and condition reports for completeness and accuracy.
* Identify and document damages, shortages, incorrect merchandise, and discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records, including item descriptions, quantities, dimensions, condition notes, and warehouse locations.
* Track merchandise across multiple warehouses and storage areas.
* Work with warehouse staff to resolve missing information, unidentified merchandise, and receiving discrepancies.
* Monitor outstanding receiving tasks and ensure incoming inventory is processed in a timely manner.

**Client Services & Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for interior designers and clients regarding inventory and warehouse requests.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client emails, requests, and questions.
* Send receiving confirmations, inspection reports, damage notifications, and inventory updates.
* Research and resolve inquiries regarding missing merchandise, status and discrepancies,
* Communicate with vendors and clients regarding damaged merchandise, returns, and replacement items.
* Maintain organized client correspondence and project records.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding issues to ensure they are resolved.

**Inventory Preparation, Work Orders & Warehouse Coordination**

* Prepare accurate, up-to-date inventory lists for upcoming deliveries, installations, and client pickups.
* Verify that requested merchandise has been received, properly documented, and is available for delivery or pickup.
* Work closely with warehouse staff to identify, locate, and resolve any inventory discrepancies or missing items.

* Coordinate client and vendor will-call requests, including preparing pickup lists and working with warehouse staff to ensure merchandise is ready for collection.

* Coordinate with warehouse personnel and outside vendors to facilitate on-site repairs, inspections, and service appointments.
* Track outstanding repairs, returns, and inventory-related issues, following through to ensure they are completed and properly documented.
* Communicate relevant inventory updates, special handling instructions, and project details to the appropriate office and warehouse personnel.
* Review completed work orders and labor records to ensure all services performed are accurately documented for billing purposes.

**Receiving Charges, Storage & Billing Support**

* Review incoming merchandise and assign receiving charges based on established company pricing guidelines.
* Learn and apply our pricing practices for different types of furniture, merchandise, and handling requirements.
* Enter and maintain storage charges and related inventory billing records.
* Identify items requiring special handling, additional labor, or charges outside standard pricing guidelines.
* Verify that receiving, storage, and additional service charges are accurately documented.
* Communicate unusual charges, discrepancies, or pricing questions to management for review.
* Maintain organized supporting records to assist with accurate client invoicing.

*Training will be provided on our pricing structure and billing procedures. These responsibilities will be introduced progressively as familiarity with our operations develops.*

**Office & Operational Support**

* Maintain organized digital records, spreadsheets, client files, and warehouse documentation.
* Collaborate with office and warehouse staff to keep daily operations efficient and organized.
* Assist with tracking outstanding tasks, project updates, returns, and unresolved inventory issues.
* Help reinforce consistent procedures for receiving, inspections, inventory management, and documentation.

new_jobs.title: Patient Care Manager -
new_jobs.description:
Our client is an early-stage healthcare and life sciences company offering highly individualized treatments. They are hiring Patient Case Managers to guide patients and their families through a complex, personalized care journey from first enquiry to follow-up. You will help shape how the company supports patients, not just follow a process someone else wrote.

What you'll do

* **Be the main point of contact** for your group of patients, their families and their physicians through regular emails and video calls, guiding each patient from first enquiry and sign-up through eligibility review, treatment preparation and delivery, and follow-up.
* **Own each patient's journey.** Collect medical data for eligibility screening, request records, manage consent paperwork and keep every step on its agreed timeline.
* **Collaborate with senior leadership and the medical and scientific teams.** Answer non-clinical questions directly and escalate clinical questions promptly through the established pathway.
* **Coordinate samples end to end.** Arrange collection and shipping with physicians, labs and other external partners, and track every sample through to results.
* **Lead sensitive conversations** about risks, costs, billing and financial aid with compassion and discretion, and arrange practical support such as travel and scheduling.
* **Build the foundations.** Create and maintain patient trackers and accurate, confidential records, and help formalize the end-to-end patient process. Over time, you may train and manage new case managers while keeping your own patient group.

What we're looking for

**Must-haves**

* Direct patient-facing or client-facing coordination experience, such as nurse navigation, patient services, case management, care coordination or clinical-trial patient support
* A proven record of handling sensitive, difficult conversations directly with patients and families, beyond administrative work behind the scenes
* Compassionate communication in distressing situations
* Roughly 2-7 years of relevant experience (strong candidates with less will be considered)
* Comfort managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across multiple external parties, with a track record of keeping every case moving and nothing dropped
* Ability to work hybrid in San Francisco, 3-4 days per week
* A degree, with a strong academic background

**Nice-to-haves**

* Oncology or other serious-illness experience
* A medical or nursing background, or nurse navigator experience
* Familiarity with HIPAA, GCP and specimen handling or chain of custody
* Experience with expanded-access, personalized or cell-based therapy programs, or clinical-trial enrolment
* Experience building processes from scratch

Pay: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94114

In this role you will own a portfolio of large, complex, and high-growth accounts across the financial services and regulated tech sectors — industries where Global Relay is deeply embedded. $35.00–$45.00/hour (DOE)

SAGE Veterinary Centers is seeking an experienced Veterinary Technician Learning & Development Specialist (TLDS) to plan, organize, and direct the clinical training and professional development of our Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.

This is a hands-on clinical role for an experienced veterinary professional who enjoys both working on the hospital floor and developing others. The TLDS continues to work as a Veterinary Technician while assessing clinical skills, training new team members, supporting onboarding, and overseeing technician continuing education for the hospital team. The division of time between the floor and training may vary based on the number of new hires, training needs, and other factors, and the specific area of focus is set by hospital leadership and may shift as hospital needs change.

**Why Join SAGE Dublin**

At SAGE Dublin, part of Ethos Veterinary Health, you’ll join one of the San Francisco Bay Area’s most respected specialty and emergency veterinary hospitals. Our team is dedicated to delivering compassionate, collaborative, and advanced veterinary care while utilizing state-of-the-art technology and innovative treatment options. Services include emergency and critical care, urgent care, internal medicine, cardiology, oncology, and surgery, and we are equally committed to fostering a positive, inclusive workplace culture focused on teamwork, learning, and professional development.

* Work hands-on as a Veterinary Technician while serving as a clinical trainer and mentor for Veterinary Technicians and Veterinary Assistants.
* Assess, train, and develop new team members as a primary focus of the role.
* Facilitate Veterinary Assistant and Veterinary Technician training across all skill levels through direct, hands-on clinical instruction and a train-the-trainer approach.
* Directly train team members in accordance with written hospital protocols.
* Plan and present clinical in-service training and educational sessions.
* Direct and oversee all technician continuing education (CE), both live and online through VetBloom and Talent Unleashed.
* Assign required VetBloom and Talent Unleashed training to all new employees.
* Partner with Clinical Supervisors to facilitate learning and development plans, including direct training and an effective, timely protocol sign-off process.
* Assist with developing, coordinating, and delivering onboarding and role-specific training across hospital departments, including ezyVet training for non-nursing roles and triage-process training for front desk teams, in collaboration with department leadership.
* Track training modules for all technician levels, including clinical competencies and non-clinical compliance training such as Code of Conduct, Handbook sign-offs, and other acknowledgements.
* Provide input into the development, standardization, and sign-off process for technician protocol practicals.
* Provide timely feedback to team members and leadership regarding training progress and development needs.
* Collaborate with the Ethos Clinical Learning & Development team and other TLDS across the Division to ensure updated training is deployed.
* Work with local Medicine and Operations teams and Regional L&D and Event Management teams on agenda planning, speaker identification, and general support of CE events for Ethos Technicians and referring DVM teams.
